﻿using System;
using System.Collections.ObjectModel;
using System.Data.SqlClient;
using System.Linq;
using System.Windows;
using System.Windows.Controls;
using Diplom_Bibl.Controls;

namespace Diplom_Bibl.Pages
{
    // Класс для причины списания
    public class ReasonDisposalBook
    {
        public int ID_Reason { get; set; }
        public string ReasonName { get; set; }
    }

    public partial class DisposalAct : Page
    {
        private readonly string _conn = "Server=DMITRIJ;Database=DiplomBibl;Integrated Security=True;";
        private readonly ObservableCollection<BookItem> _items = new ObservableCollection<BookItem>();
        private int _nextRowNum = 1;
        private int? _currentWriteOffId = null;

        public DisposalAct()
        {
            InitializeComponent();
            DgItems.ItemsSource = _items;
            LoadReasons();
            DpDate.SelectedDate = DateTime.Today;

            // Генерируем следующий номер акта
            string nextNumber = GetNextDisposalNumber();
            TbActNumber.Text = nextNumber;
        }

        private class BookItem
        {
            public int RowNum { get; set; }
            public string InventoryNumber { get; set; }
            public string Author { get; set; }
            public string Title { get; set; }
            public string PublishingHouse { get; set; }
            public int Year { get; set; }
            public int PriceRub { get; set; }
            public int PriceKop { get; set; }
            public int Quantity { get; set; }
            public decimal TotalPrice => (PriceRub + PriceKop / 100m) * Quantity;
            public string PlaceYear => $"{PublishingHouse}, {Year}";
        }

        private class BookStatusCheckResult
        {
            public bool CanBeDisposed { get; set; }
            public string Message { get; set; }
            public bool IsIssued { get; set; }
            public string IssuedInfo { get; set; }
        }

        private void LoadReasons()
        {
            try
            {
                const string sql = "SELECT ID_Reason, ReasonName FROM ReasonDisposalBook ORDER BY ReasonName";
                var reasons = new ObservableCollection<ReasonDisposalBook>();

                using (var conn = new SqlConnection(_conn))
                {
                    conn.Open();
                    using (var cmd = new SqlCommand(sql, conn))
                    using (var reader = cmd.ExecuteReader())
                    {
                        while (reader.Read())
                        {
                            reasons.Add(new ReasonDisposalBook
                            {
                                ID_Reason = Convert.ToInt32(reader["ID_Reason"]),
                                ReasonName = reader["ReasonName"].ToString()
                            });
                        }
                    }
                }

                CbReason.ItemsSource = reasons;
                CbReason.DisplayMemberPath = "ReasonName";
                CbReason.SelectedValuePath = "ID_Reason";
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                 CustomMessageBox.Show($"Ошибка загрузки причин: {ex.Message}");
            }
        }

        private void BtnFindBook_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
        {
            string inv = TbSearchInv.Text.Trim();

            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(inv))
            {
                 CustomMessageBox.Show("Введите инвентарный номер книги!");
                return;
            }

            // Проверка дубликатов в текущем акте
            if (_items.Any(item => item.InventoryNumber == inv))
            {
                 CustomMessageBox.Show($"Книга {inv} уже добавлена в акт.");
                TbSearchInv.Clear();
                return;
            }

            // Проверка статуса книги
            var bookCheckResult = CheckBookStatus(inv);
            if (!bookCheckResult.CanBeDisposed)
            {
                // Если книга выдана, показываем подробную информацию
                if (bookCheckResult.Message.Contains("находится на руках"))
                {
                    string issuedInfo = GetIssuedInfo(inv);
                     CustomMessageBox.Show($"{bookCheckResult.Message}\n\n{issuedInfo}",
                        "Невозможно списать", CustomMessageBoxButton.OK, CustomMessageBoxImage.Warning);
                }
                else
                {
                     CustomMessageBox.Show(bookCheckResult.Message);
                }
                TbSearchInv.Clear();
                return;
            }

            var book = LoadBookByInventory(inv);
            if (book != null)
            {
                LbInventory.Text = book.InventoryNumber;
                LbTitle.Text = $"{book.Author} — {book.Title}";
                LbPubYear.Text = book.PlaceYear;
                LbPrice.Text = $"{book.PriceRub}.{book.PriceKop:D2} руб.";
                PnBookDetails.Visibility = Visibility.Visible;
                TbSearchInv.IsEnabled = false;
            }
        }

        private BookStatusCheckResult CheckBookStatus(string inventoryNumber)
        {
            const string sql = @"
                SELECT 
                    b.ID_Disposal,
                    s.Title_Status AS StatusName,
                    b.StatusBook,
                    CASE 
                        WHEN bi.ReaderId IS NOT NULL OR gi.GroupIssuanceId IS NOT NULL THEN 1 
                        ELSE 0 
                    END AS IsIssued
                FROM Books b
                LEFT JOIN StatusBook s ON b.StatusBook = s.ID_Status
                LEFT JOIN BookIssuance bi ON b.IDBook = bi.BookId AND bi.ReturnDate IS NULL
                LEFT JOIN GroupIssuanceItems git ON b.IDBook = git.BookId
                LEFT JOIN GroupBookIssuance gi ON git.GroupIssuanceId = gi.GroupIssuanceId AND gi.ReturnDate IS NULL
                WHERE b.InventaryNumber = @Inv";

            using (var conn = new SqlConnection(_conn))
            {
                conn.Open();
                using (var cmd = new SqlCommand(sql, conn))
                {
                    cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@Inv", inventoryNumber);
                    using (var reader = cmd.ExecuteReader())
                    {
                        if (reader.Read())
                        {
                            // Проверяем, выдана ли книга
                            bool isIssued = Convert.ToInt32(reader["IsIssued"]) == 1;

                            if (isIssued)
                            {
                                return new BookStatusCheckResult
                                {
                                    CanBeDisposed = false,
                                    Message = $"Книга {inventoryNumber} находится на руках у читателя. Сначала необходимо вернуть книгу.",
                                    IsIssued = true
                                };
                            }

                            // Проверяем ID_Disposal
                            if (reader["ID_Disposal"] != DBNull.Value)
                            {
                                return new BookStatusCheckResult
                                {
                                    CanBeDisposed = false,
                                    Message = $"Книга {inventoryNumber} уже списана."
                                };
                            }

                            string statusName = reader["StatusName"]?.ToString() ?? "";
                            if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(statusName) && statusName.ToLower().Contains("списана"))
                            {
                                return new BookStatusCheckResult
                                {
                                    CanBeDisposed = false,
                                    Message = $"Книга имеет статус '{statusName}'."
                                };
                            }

                            return new BookStatusCheckResult { CanBeDisposed = true, Message = "" };
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            return new BookStatusCheckResult { CanBeDisposed = false, Message = "Книга не найдена" };
        }

        private string GetIssuedInfo(string inventoryNumber)
        {
            const string sql = @"
                SELECT 
                    CASE 
                        WHEN bi.ReaderId IS NOT NULL THEN 
                            'читателю ' + r.LastName + ' ' + r.FirstName + ' ' + ISNULL(r.MiddleName, '')
                        WHEN gi.GroupIssuanceId IS NOT NULL THEN 
                            'группе ' + g.GroupCode + ' (преп. ' + t.LastName + ' ' + t.FirstName + ')'
                        ELSE ''
                    END AS RecipientInfo,
                    CASE 
                        WHEN bi.ReaderId IS NOT NULL THEN bi.IssuanceDate
                        WHEN gi.GroupIssuanceId IS NOT NULL THEN gi.IssuanceDate
                        ELSE NULL
                    END AS IssueDate,
                    CASE 
                        WHEN bi.ReaderId IS NOT NULL THEN bi.PlannedReturnDate
                        WHEN gi.GroupIssuanceId IS NOT NULL THEN gi.PlannedReturnDate
                        ELSE NULL
                    END AS PlannedReturnDate
                FROM Books b
                LEFT JOIN BookIssuance bi ON b.IDBook = bi.BookId AND bi.ReturnDate IS NULL
                LEFT JOIN ReaderForm r ON bi.ReaderId = r.ReaderID
                LEFT JOIN GroupIssuanceItems git ON b.IDBook = git.BookId
                LEFT JOIN GroupBookIssuance gi ON git.GroupIssuanceId = gi.GroupIssuanceId AND gi.ReturnDate IS NULL
                LEFT JOIN Groups g ON gi.GroupId = g.GroupID
                LEFT JOIN ReaderForm t ON gi.TeacherId = t.ReaderID
                WHERE b.InventaryNumber = @Inv";

            using (var conn = new SqlConnection(_conn))
            {
                conn.Open();
                using (var cmd = new SqlCommand(sql, conn))
                {
                    cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@Inv", inventoryNumber);
                    using (var reader = cmd.ExecuteReader())
                    {
                        if (reader.Read())
                        {
                            string recipientInfo = reader["RecipientInfo"]?.ToString() ?? "";
                            DateTime? issueDate = reader["IssueDate"] != DBNull.Value ? Convert.ToDateTime(reader["IssueDate"]) : (DateTime?)null;
                            DateTime? plannedReturnDate = reader["PlannedReturnDate"] != DBNull.Value ? Convert.ToDateTime(reader["PlannedReturnDate"]) : (DateTime?)null;

                            string result = recipientInfo;
                            if (issueDate.HasValue)
                            {
                                result += $"\nДата выдачи: {issueDate.Value:dd.MM.yyyy}";
                            }
                            if (plannedReturnDate.HasValue)
                            {
                                result += $"\nПлановая дата возврата: {plannedReturnDate.Value:dd.MM.yyyy}";
                                if (plannedReturnDate.Value < DateTime.Today)
                                {
                                    result += "\nВНИМАНИЕ: Просрочена!";
                                }
                            }
                            return result;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            return "";
        }

        private BookItem LoadBookByInventory(string inv)
        {
            const string sql = @"
                SELECT 
                    b.InventaryNumber AS Inv,
                    b.TitleBook AS Title,
                    ISNULL(a.SurnameAuthor + ' ' + a.NameAuthor + ' ' + a.PatronymicAuthor, '') AS Author,
                    ISNULL(p.TitlePublishingHouse, '') AS Pub,
                    b.YearPublishing AS Year,
                    CAST(FLOOR(ISNULL(b.Price, 0)) AS int) AS PriceRub,
                    CAST((ISNULL(b.Price, 0) - FLOOR(ISNULL(b.Price, 0))) * 100 AS int) AS PriceKop,
                    CASE 
                        WHEN bi.ReaderId IS NOT NULL OR gi.GroupIssuanceId IS NOT NULL THEN 1 
                        ELSE 0 
                    END AS IsIssued
                FROM Books b
                LEFT JOIN Authors a ON b.Author = a.ID_Autor
                LEFT JOIN PublishingHouse p ON b.PublishingHouse = p.IDPublishingHouse
                LEFT JOIN BookIssuance bi ON b.IDBook = bi.BookId AND bi.ReturnDate IS NULL
                LEFT JOIN GroupIssuanceItems git ON b.IDBook = git.BookId
                LEFT JOIN GroupBookIssuance gi ON git.GroupIssuanceId = gi.GroupIssuanceId AND gi.ReturnDate IS NULL
                WHERE b.InventaryNumber = @Inv";

            using (var conn = new SqlConnection(_conn))
            {
                conn.Open();
                using (var cmd = new SqlCommand(sql, conn))
                {
                    cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@Inv", inv);
                    using (var reader = cmd.ExecuteReader())
                    {
                        if (reader.Read())
                        {
                            bool isIssued = Convert.ToInt32(reader["IsIssued"]) == 1;

                            if (isIssued)
                            {
                                // Книга выдана, показываем информацию
                                string issuedInfo = GetIssuedInfo(inv);
                                 CustomMessageBox.Show($"Книга {inv} находится на руках!\n\n{issuedInfo}",
                                    "Невозможно списать", CustomMessageBoxButton.OK, CustomMessageBoxImage.Warning);
                                return null;
                            }

                            return new BookItem
                            {
                                InventoryNumber = reader["Inv"].ToString(),
                                Title = reader["Title"].ToString(),
                                Author = reader["Author"].ToString(),
                                PublishingHouse = reader["Pub"].ToString(),
                                Year = Convert.ToInt32(reader["Year"]),
                                PriceRub = Convert.ToInt32(reader["PriceRub"]),
                                PriceKop = Convert.ToInt32(reader["PriceKop"])
                            };
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            return null;
        }

        private void BtnAddToAct_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
        {
            try
            {
                // Проверяем, что все необходимые поля заполнены
                if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(LbInventory.Text) || LbInventory.Text == "не найдена")
                {
                     CustomMessageBox.Show("Сначала найдите книгу по инвентарному номеру.", "Ошибка",
                        CustomMessageBoxButton.OK, CustomMessageBoxImage.Warning);
                    return;
                }

                // Парсим цену
                string priceText = LbPrice.Text.Replace(" руб.", "").Trim();
                string[] priceParts = priceText.Split('.');
                int priceRub = int.Parse(priceParts[0]);
                int priceKop = priceParts.Length > 1 ? int.Parse(priceParts[1]) : 0;

                // Парсим год и издательство
                string pubYearText = LbPubYear.Text;
                string publishingHouse = "";
                int year = DateTime.Now.Year;

                if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(pubYearText) && pubYearText.Contains(","))
                {
                    var parts = pubYearText.Split(',');
                    publishingHouse = parts[0].Trim();
                    if (parts.Length > 1 && int.TryParse(parts[1].Trim(), out int parsedYear))
                    {
                        year = parsedYear;
                    }
                }

                // Парсим название и автора
                string titleText = LbTitle.Text;
                string author = "";
                string title = titleText;

                if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(titleText) && titleText.Contains("—"))
                {
                    var parts = titleText.Split('—');
                    author = parts[0].Trim();
                    title = parts.Length > 1 ? parts[1].Trim() : titleText;
                }

                var item = new BookItem
                {
                    RowNum = _nextRowNum++,
                    InventoryNumber = LbInventory.Text,
                    Title = title,
                    Author = author,
                    PublishingHouse = publishingHouse,
                    Year = year,
                    PriceRub = priceRub,
                    PriceKop = priceKop,
                    Quantity = 1
                };

                _items.Add(item);

                // Показываем DataGrid и обновляем UI
                DgItems.Visibility = Visibility.Visible;
                DgItems.ItemsSource = _items;

                // Показываем заголовок таблицы и панель итогов
                TableHeader.Visibility = Visibility.Visible;
                TotalPanel.Visibility = Visibility.Visible;

                // Скрываем панель с деталями книги
                PnBookDetails.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;

                // Очищаем поле поиска
                TbSearchInv.Clear();
                TbSearchInv.IsEnabled = true;

                // Обновляем счетчик книг
                BooksCountLabel.Text = $"(всего: {_items.Count} книг)";

                // Обновляем итоговую сумму
                UpdateTotal();

                // Очищаем поля найденной книги
                ClearBookDetails();

                 CustomMessageBox.Show($"Книга '{title}' добавлена в акт списания.", "Успешно",
                    CustomMessageBoxButton.OK, CustomMessageBoxImage.Information);
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                 CustomMessageBox.Show($"Ошибка при добавлении книги: {ex.Message}", "Ошибка",
                    CustomMessageBoxButton.OK, CustomMessageBoxImage.Error);
            }
        }

        private void ClearBookDetails()
        {
            LbInventory.Text = "";
            LbTitle.Text = "";
            LbPubYear.Text = "";
            LbPrice.Text = "";
        }

        private void UpdateTotal()
        {
            decimal total = 0;
            foreach (var i in _items)
            {
                total += i.TotalPrice;
            }
            TbTotal.Text = total.ToString("N2");
        }

        private void BtnGenerateAct_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
        {
            if (_items.Count == 0)
            {
                CustomMessageBox.Show("Добавьте книги в акт.");
                return;
            }

            if (CbReason.SelectedItem == null)
            {
                CustomMessageBox.Show("Выберите причину списания.");
                return;
            }

            var selectedReason = (ReasonDisposalBook)CbReason.SelectedItem;
            string actNumber = TbActNumber.Text.Trim();
            string participants = TbParticipants.Text.Trim();

            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(actNumber) || string.IsNullOrEmpty(participants))
            {
                CustomMessageBox.Show("Заполните все поля.");
                return;
            }

            try
            {
                using (var conn = new SqlConnection(_conn))
                {
                    conn.Open();
                    using (var transaction = conn.BeginTransaction())
                    {
                        try
                        {
                            // 1. Создаем акт списания
                            int writeOffId;
                            using (var cmd = new SqlCommand(@"
                        INSERT INTO DisposalBooks (DisposalNumber, DisposalDate, Participants, Reason)
                        VALUES (@Number, @Date, @Participants, @Reason);
                        SELECT SCOPE_IDENTITY();", conn, transaction))
                            {
                                cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@Number", actNumber);
                                cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@Date", DpDate.SelectedDate ?? DateTime.Today);
                                cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@Participants", participants);
                                cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@Reason", selectedReason.ID_Reason);

                                writeOffId = Convert.ToInt32(cmd.ExecuteScalar());
                                _currentWriteOffId = writeOffId;
                            }

                            // 2. Получаем ID статуса "Списана"
                            int disposedStatusId = GetDisposedStatusId(conn, transaction);

                            // 3. Добавляем книги в DisposalItems и обновляем Books
                            foreach (var item in _items)
                            {
                                using (var cmd = new SqlCommand(@"
                            INSERT INTO DisposalItems (IDDisposal, InventoryNumber, TitleBook, PriceRub, PriceKop, Quantity, TotalPrice)
                            VALUES (@ID, @Inv, @Title, @Rub, @Kop, @Qty, @Total);
                            
                            UPDATE Books 
                            SET ID_Disposal = @ID, StatusBook = @StatusId
                            WHERE InventaryNumber = @Inv;", conn, transaction))
                                {
                                    cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@ID", writeOffId);
                                    cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@Inv", item.InventoryNumber);
                                    cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@Title", item.Title);
                                    cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@Rub", item.PriceRub);
                                    cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@Kop", item.PriceKop);
                                    cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@Qty", item.Quantity);
                                    cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@Total", item.TotalPrice);
                                    cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@StatusId", disposedStatusId);

                                    cmd.ExecuteNonQuery();
                                }
                            }

                            transaction.Commit();

                            // Генерируем PDF-документ
                            byte[] pdfBytes = Services.DisposalActPdfService.GenerateDisposalActPdf(writeOffId);

                            // Сохраняем PDF на рабочий стол
                            string desktop = Environment.GetFolderPath(Environment.SpecialFolder.Desktop);
                            string fileName = $"Акт_списания_{actNumber}_{DateTime.Now:yyyyMMdd_HHmm}.pdf";
                            string fullPath = System.IO.Path.Combine(desktop, fileName);
                            System.IO.File.WriteAllBytes(fullPath, pdfBytes);

                            CustomMessageBox.Show($"Акт списания успешно создан!\n\nPDF сохранён:\n{fullPath}", "Успешно",
                                CustomMessageBoxButton.OK, CustomMessageBoxImage.Information);

                            ClearForm();
                        }
                        catch
                        {
                            transaction.Rollback();
                            throw;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                CustomMessageBox.Show($"Ошибка: {ex.Message}", "Ошибка",
                    CustomMessageBoxButton.OK, CustomMessageBoxImage.Error);
            }
        }

        private int GetDisposedStatusId(SqlConnection conn, SqlTransaction transaction)
        {
            using (var cmd = new SqlCommand(
                "SELECT ID_Status FROM StatusBook WHERE Title_Status LIKE '%Списана%'",
                conn, transaction))
            {
                var result = cmd.ExecuteScalar();
                return result != null ? Convert.ToInt32(result) : 1;
            }
        }

        private void ClearForm()
        {
            TbActNumber.Text = GetNextDisposalNumber();
            DpDate.SelectedDate = DateTime.Today;
            TbParticipants.Clear();
            CbReason.SelectedIndex = -1;
            _items.Clear();
            _nextRowNum = 1;
            TbTotal.Text = "0.00";
            PnBookDetails.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
            TbSearchInv.IsEnabled = true;
            DgItems.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
            TableHeader.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
            TotalPanel.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
        }

        private string GetNextDisposalNumber()
        {
            using (var conn = new SqlConnection(_conn))
            {
                conn.Open();
                using (var cmd = new SqlCommand(
                    "SELECT ISNULL(MAX(CAST(SUBSTRING(DisposalNumber, 4, 4) AS INT)), 0) FROM DisposalBooks",
                    conn))
                {
                    int lastNum = Convert.ToInt32(cmd.ExecuteScalar());
                    return $"СП-{(lastNum + 1):D4}";
                }
            }
        }

        private void BtnClose_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
        {
            NavigationService?.GoBack();
        }
    }
}

=== ФАЙЛ: ./Diplom_Bibl/Pages/DisposalActPdfService.cs ===
﻿using iTextSharp.text;
using iTextSharp.text.pdf;
using System;
using System.Data.SqlClient;
using System.IO;

namespace Diplom_Bibl.Services
{
    public static class DisposalActPdfService
    {
        private const string ConnectionString = "Server=DMITRIJ;Database=DiplomBibl;Integrated Security=True;Encrypt=False;";

        public static byte[] GenerateDisposalActPdf(int writeOffId)
        {
            try
            {
                //var book = LoadItems(writeOffId);
                //string booktitle = LoadItems(book.TitleBook);

                var act = LoadAct(writeOffId);
                if (act == null) throw new ArgumentException("Акт списания не найден.");

                // Получаем текст причины по ID
                string reasonText = GetReasonName(act.ReasonID);
                var items = LoadItems(writeOffId);
                int totalCopies = 0;
                decimal totalSum = 0;
                foreach (var item in items)
                {
                    totalCopies += item.Quantity;
                    totalSum += item.TotalPrice;
                }

                using (var ms = new MemoryStream())
                {
                    Document document = new Document(PageSize.A4, 50, 50, 50, 50);
                    PdfWriter writer = PdfWriter.GetInstance(document, ms);
                    document.Open();

                    // === Надёжная загрузка Arial с поддержкой кириллицы ===
                    BaseFont baseFont;
                    try
                    {
                        baseFont = BaseFont.CreateFont(@"C:\Windows\Fonts\arial.ttf", BaseFont.IDENTITY_H, BaseFont.EMBEDDED);
                    }
                    catch
                    {
                        // Fallback: стандартный шрифт с поддержкой UTF-8
                        baseFont = BaseFont.CreateFont(BaseFont.HELVETICA, BaseFont.CP1250, BaseFont.NOT_EMBEDDED);
                    }

                    Font fontNormal = new Font(baseFont, 11);
                    Font fontBold = new Font(baseFont, 11, Font.BOLD);
                    Font fontHeader = new Font(baseFont, 16, Font.BOLD);

                    // === Заголовок ===
                    Paragraph title = new Paragraph($"Акт N {act.DisposalNumber}", fontHeader);
                    title.Alignment = Element.ALIGN_LEFT;
                    document.Add(title);
                    document.Add(new Paragraph(" "));

                    // === Дата ===
                    string month = GetMonthNameRu(act.DisposalDate.Month);
                    string dateLine = $"Настоящий акт составлен \"{act.DisposalDate.Day}\" {month} {act.DisposalDate.Year} г.";
                    document.Add(new Paragraph(dateLine, fontNormal));
                    document.Add(new Paragraph(" "));

                    // === Участники ===
                    document.Add(new Paragraph(act.Participants, fontNormal));
                    document.Add(new Paragraph("(фамилии, имена, отчества и должности лиц, участвующих", fontNormal));
                    document.Add(new Paragraph("в составлении акта)", fontNormal));
                    document.Add(new Paragraph(" "));

                    // === Основание списания ===
                    document.Add(new Paragraph($"о списании из библиотеки  {reasonText}", fontNormal));
                    document.Add(new Paragraph("(вид документа и основание: ветхость, утрата и т.п.)", fontNormal));
                    document.Add(new Paragraph(" "));

                    // === Итоговая сумма ===
                    string totalRub = Math.Floor(totalSum).ToString("N0");
                    string totalKop = ((int)(totalSum * 100) % 100).ToString("D2");
                    string totalWords = NumberToWordsRubles((int)totalSum);

                    document.Add(new Paragraph($"в количестве {totalCopies} экземпляров на общую сумму {totalRub} руб. {totalKop} коп.", fontNormal));
                    document.Add(new Paragraph($"({totalWords})", fontNormal));
                    document.Add(new Paragraph(" "));

                    // === Примечание ===
                    document.Add(new Paragraph("Список книг (или других документов) прилагается.", fontNormal));
                    document.Add(new Paragraph(" "));

                    // === Подписи ===
                    document.Add(new Paragraph("Подписи ________________________________________ (руководителя)", fontNormal));
                    document.Add(new Paragraph("________________________________________ (сотрудника)", fontNormal));
                    document.Add(new Paragraph("________________________________________ (лица, принявшего документы)", fontNormal));
                    document.Add(new Paragraph(" "));

                    // === Таблица ===
                    document.Add(new Paragraph($"Список книг или других документов к акту N {act.DisposalNumber}*", fontBold));
                    document.Add(new Paragraph(" "));

                    PdfPTable table = new PdfPTable(6);
                    table.WidthPercentage = 100;
                    table.SetWidths(new float[] { 5f, 30f, 5f, 5f, 8f, 10f });

                    table.AddCell(new PdfPCell(new Phrase("N п/п", fontBold)));
                    table.AddCell(new PdfPCell(new Phrase("Автор, заглавие книги или вид документа", fontBold)));
                    table.AddCell(new PdfPCell(new Phrase("руб.", fontBold)));
                    table.AddCell(new PdfPCell(new Phrase("коп.", fontBold)));
                    table.AddCell(new PdfPCell(new Phrase("Кол-во экз.", fontBold)));
                    table.AddCell(new PdfPCell(new Phrase("Сумма", fontBold)));

                    for (int i = 0; i < items.Length; i++)
                    {
                        var item = items[i];
                        table.AddCell(new PdfPCell(new Phrase((i + 1).ToString(), fontNormal)));
                        table.AddCell(new PdfPCell(new Phrase(item.TitleBook, fontNormal)));
                        table.AddCell(new PdfPCell(new Phrase(item.PriceRub.ToString(), fontNormal)));
                        table.AddCell(new PdfPCell(new Phrase(item.PriceKop.ToString(), fontNormal)));
                        table.AddCell(new PdfPCell(new Phrase(item.Quantity.ToString(), fontNormal)));
                        table.AddCell(new PdfPCell(new Phrase($"{item.TotalPrice:N2}", fontNormal)));
                    }

                    document.Add(table);
                    document.Close();
                    return ms.ToArray();
                }
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                throw new Exception($"Ошибка генерации PDF: {ex.Message}", ex);
            }
        }

        // === ВСПОМОГАТЕЛЬНЫЕ МЕТОДЫ ===

        private static string GetMonthNameRu(int month)
        {
            var months = new[]
            {
                "января", "февраля", "марта", "апреля", "мая", "июня",
                "июля", "августа", "сентября", "октября", "ноября", "декабря"
            };
            return months[month - 1];
        }

        private static string NumberToWordsRubles(int number)
        {
            if (number == 0) return "ноль рублей 00 копеек";
            // Для диплома можно оставить цифры
            return $"{number} рублей 00 копеек";
        }

        // === ЗАГРУЗКА ДАННЫХ ===

        private static ActData LoadAct(int id)
        {
            const string sql = @"
                SELECT DisposalNumber, DisposalDate, Participants, Reason
                FROM DisposalBooks
                WHERE IDDisposal = @Id";

            using (var conn = new SqlConnection(ConnectionString))
            {
                conn.Open();
                using (var cmd = new SqlCommand(sql, conn))
                {
                    cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@Id", id);
                    using (var reader = cmd.ExecuteReader())
                    {
                        if (reader.Read())
                        {
                            return new ActData
                            {
                                DisposalNumber = reader["DisposalNumber"].ToString(),
                                DisposalDate = Convert.ToDateTime(reader["DisposalDate"]),
                                Participants = reader["Participants"].ToString(),
                                ReasonID = Convert.ToInt32(reader["Reason"])
                            };
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            return null;
        }

        private static string GetReasonName(int reasonId)
        {
            const string sql = "SELECT ReasonName FROM ReasonDisposalBook WHERE ID_Reason = @Id";
            using (var conn = new SqlConnection(ConnectionString))
            {
                conn.Open();
                using (var cmd = new SqlCommand(sql, conn))
                {
                    cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@Id", reasonId);
                    var result = cmd.ExecuteScalar();
                    return result?.ToString() ?? "Не указано";
                }
            }
        }

        private static ItemData[] LoadItems(int writeOffId)
        {
            var list = new System.Collections.Generic.List<ItemData>();
            const string sql = @"
                SELECT TitleBook, PriceRub, PriceKop, Quantity,
                       (PriceRub + PriceKop / 100.0) * Quantity AS TotalPrice
                FROM DisposalItems
                WHERE IDDisposal = @Id";

            using (var conn = new SqlConnection(ConnectionString))
            {
                conn.Open();
                using (var cmd = new SqlCommand(sql, conn))
                {
                    cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@Id", writeOffId);
                    using (var reader = cmd.ExecuteReader())
                    {
                        while (reader.Read())
                        {
                            list.Add(new ItemData
                            {
                                TitleBook = reader["TitleBook"].ToString(),
                                PriceRub = Convert.ToInt32(reader["PriceRub"]),
                                PriceKop = Convert.ToInt32(reader["PriceKop"]),
                                Quantity = Convert.ToInt32(reader["Quantity"]),
                                TotalPrice = Convert.ToDecimal(reader["TotalPrice"])
                            });
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            return list.ToArray();
        }

        // === DTO ===
        private class ActData
        {
            public string DisposalNumber { get; set; }
            public DateTime DisposalDate { get; set; }
            public string Participants { get; set; }
            public int ReasonID { get; set; } // ← теперь int
        }

        private class ItemData
        {
            public string TitleBook { get; set; }
            public int PriceRub { get; set; }
            public int PriceKop { get; set; }
            public int Quantity { get; set; }
            public decimal TotalPrice { get; set; }
        }
    }
}

﻿using System;
using System.Collections.ObjectModel;
using System.Data.SqlClient;
using System.Linq;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using System.Windows;
using System.Windows.Controls;
using System.Windows.Input;
using System.Windows.Media;
using Diplom_Bibl.Controls;

namespace Diplom_Bibl.Pages
{
    public partial class FundMovementPage : Page
    {
        private readonly string _connectionString = "Server=DMITRIJ;Database=DiplomBibl;Integrated Security=True;";
        private ObservableCollection<FundMovementItem> _allItems;
        private bool _isPlaceholderActive = true;

        public class FundMovementItem
        {
            public string IssuanceType { get; set; }
            public int Id { get; set; }
            public DateTime IssuanceDate { get; set; }
            public DateTime PlannedReturnDate { get; set; }
            public DateTime? ReturnDate { get; set; }
            public string Status { get; set; }
            public int RecipientId { get; set; }
            public string RecipientName { get; set; }
            public string RecipientType { get; set; }
            public string GroupCode { get; set; }
            public string TeacherName { get; set; }
            public string StudentName { get; set; }
            public int IDBook { get; set; }
            public string BookTitle { get; set; }
            public string InventaryNumber { get; set; }
            public int Quantity { get; set; }
            public int ReturnedQuantity { get; set; }
            public bool IsOverdue { get; set; }
            public int DaysRemaining { get; set; }
            public string Notes { get; set; }

            // Вычисляемые свойства для отображения
            public string IssuanceTypeDisplay => IssuanceType == "individual" ? "Индивидуальная" : "Групповая";
            public string RecipientDisplay => $"{RecipientName} ({RecipientType})";
            public string GroupTeacherDisplay => !string.IsNullOrEmpty(GroupCode) ? $"Группа: {GroupCode}" :
                                                  !string.IsNullOrEmpty(TeacherName) ? $"Преп: {TeacherName}" : "—";
            public string StatusDisplay => ReturnDate.HasValue ? "Возвращена" :
                                            IsOverdue ? "Просрочена" : "Активна";

            public SolidColorBrush StatusColor
            {
                get
                {
                    if (ReturnDate.HasValue)
                        return new SolidColorBrush((Color)ColorConverter.ConvertFromString("#6C757D"));
                    if (IsOverdue)
                        return new SolidColorBrush((Color)ColorConverter.ConvertFromString("#DC3545"));
                    return new SolidColorBrush((Color)ColorConverter.ConvertFromString("#28A745"));
                }
            }
        }

        public FundMovementPage()
        {
            InitializeComponent();
        }

        private async void Page_Loaded(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
        {
            await LoadDataAsync();
        }

        private async Task LoadDataAsync()
        {
            try
            {
                LoadingPanel.Visibility = Visibility.Visible;
                FundMovementGrid.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;

                await Task.Run(() =>
                {
                    var items = new ObservableCollection<FundMovementItem>();

                    const string sql = @"
                        SELECT 
                            IssuanceType,
                            Id,
                            IssuanceDate,
                            PlannedReturnDate,
                            ReturnDate,
                            Status,
                            RecipientId,
                            RecipientName,
                            RecipientType,
                            GroupCode,
                            TeacherName,
                            StudentName,
                            BookId,
                            BookTitle,
                            InventaryNumber,
                            Quantity,
                            ReturnedQuantity,
                            IsOverdue,
                            DaysRemaining,
                            Notes
                        FROM vw_FundMovement
                        ORDER BY IsOverdue DESC, PlannedReturnDate";

                    using (var conn = new SqlConnection(_connectionString))
                    {
                        conn.Open();
                        using (var cmd = new SqlCommand(sql, conn))
                        using (var reader = cmd.ExecuteReader())
                        {
                            while (reader.Read())
                            {
                                items.Add(new FundMovementItem
                                {
                                    IssuanceType = reader["IssuanceType"]?.ToString() ?? "",
                                    Id = Convert.ToInt32(reader["Id"]),
                                    IssuanceDate = Convert.ToDateTime(reader["IssuanceDate"]),
                                    PlannedReturnDate = Convert.ToDateTime(reader["PlannedReturnDate"]),
                                    ReturnDate = reader["ReturnDate"] != DBNull.Value ? Convert.ToDateTime(reader["ReturnDate"]) : (DateTime?)null,
                                    Status = reader["Status"]?.ToString() ?? "",
                                    RecipientId = Convert.ToInt32(reader["RecipientId"]),
                                    RecipientName = reader["RecipientName"]?.ToString() ?? "",
                                    RecipientType = reader["RecipientType"]?.ToString() ?? "",
                                    GroupCode = reader["GroupCode"]?.ToString() ?? "",
                                    TeacherName = reader["TeacherName"]?.ToString() ?? "",
                                    StudentName = reader["StudentName"]?.ToString() ?? "",
                                    IDBook = Convert.ToInt32(reader["BookId"]),
                                    BookTitle = reader["BookTitle"]?.ToString() ?? "",
                                    InventaryNumber = reader["InventaryNumber"]?.ToString() ?? "",
                                    Quantity = Convert.ToInt32(reader["Quantity"]),
                                    ReturnedQuantity = reader["ReturnedQuantity"] != DBNull.Value ? Convert.ToInt32(reader["ReturnedQuantity"]) : 0,
                                    IsOverdue = Convert.ToBoolean(reader["IsOverdue"]),
                                    DaysRemaining = Convert.ToInt32(reader["DaysRemaining"]),
                                    Notes = reader["Notes"]?.ToString() ?? ""
                                });
                            }
                        }
                    }

                    Dispatcher.Invoke(() =>
                    {
                        _allItems = items;
                        ApplyFilters();
                        UpdateStatistics();
                    });
                });
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                 CustomMessageBox.Show($"Ошибка загрузки данных: {ex.Message}", "Ошибка",
                    CustomMessageBoxButton.OK, CustomMessageBoxImage.Error);
            }
            finally
            {
                LoadingPanel.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
                FundMovementGrid.Visibility = Visibility.Visible;
            }
        }

        private void ApplyFilters()
        {
            if (_allItems == null) return;

            string searchTerm = SearchBox.Text.Trim();
            if (_isPlaceholderActive || searchTerm == "Поиск по книге, читателю, группе...")
                searchTerm = "";

            string typeFilter = (TypeFilterCombo.SelectedItem as ComboBoxItem)?.Content?.ToString() ?? "Все выдачи";
            string statusFilter = (StatusFilterCombo.SelectedItem as ComboBoxItem)?.Content?.ToString() ?? "Все";

            var filtered = _allItems.AsEnumerable();

            // Поиск
            if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(searchTerm))
            {
                filtered = filtered.Where(i =>
                    i.BookTitle.ToLower().Contains(searchTerm.ToLower()) ||
                    i.RecipientName.ToLower().Contains(searchTerm.ToLower()) ||
                    i.InventaryNumber.ToLower().Contains(searchTerm.ToLower()) ||
                    (i.GroupCode?.ToLower().Contains(searchTerm.ToLower()) ?? false) ||
                    (i.TeacherName?.ToLower().Contains(searchTerm.ToLower()) ?? false)
                );
            }

            // Фильтр по типу
            if (typeFilter == "Индивидуальные")
                filtered = filtered.Where(i => i.IssuanceType == "individual");
            else if (typeFilter == "Групповые")
                filtered = filtered.Where(i => i.IssuanceType == "group");

            // Фильтр по статусу
            if (statusFilter == "Активные")
                filtered = filtered.Where(i => !i.ReturnDate.HasValue && !i.IsOverdue);
            else if (statusFilter == "Просроченные")
                filtered = filtered.Where(i => !i.ReturnDate.HasValue && i.IsOverdue);
            else if (statusFilter == "Возвращенные")
                filtered = filtered.Where(i => i.ReturnDate.HasValue);

            FundMovementGrid.ItemsSource = filtered.ToList();
        }

        private void UpdateStatistics()
        {
            if (_allItems == null) return;

            var activeItems = _allItems.Where(i => !i.ReturnDate.HasValue);
            var overdueItems = activeItems.Where(i => i.IsOverdue);

            TotalIssuedText.Text = activeItems.Sum(i => i.Quantity).ToString();
            OverdueText.Text = overdueItems.Sum(i => i.Quantity).ToString();

            StudentsCountText.Text = _allItems
                .Where(i => i.RecipientType == "Читатель")
                .Select(i => i.RecipientId)
                .Distinct()
                .Count()
                .ToString();

            GroupIssuancesText.Text = _allItems.Count(i => i.IssuanceType == "group" && !i.ReturnDate.HasValue).ToString();
            IndividualIssuancesText.Text = _allItems.Count(i => i.IssuanceType == "individual" && !i.ReturnDate.HasValue).ToString();
        }

        private void SearchBox_GotFocus(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
        {
            if (_isPlaceholderActive && SearchBox.Text == "Поиск по книге, читателю, группе...")
            {
                SearchBox.Text = "";
                SearchBox.Foreground = Brushes.Black;
                _isPlaceholderActive = false;
            }
        }

        private void SearchBox_LostFocus(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(SearchBox.Text))
            {
                SearchBox.Text = "Поиск по книге, читателю, группе...";
                SearchBox.Foreground = Brushes.Gray;
                _isPlaceholderActive = true;
                ApplyFilters();
            }
        }

        private void SearchBox_TextChanged(object sender, TextChangedEventArgs e)
        {
            if (_isPlaceholderActive) return;
            ApplyFilters();
        }

        private void FilterCombo_SelectionChanged(object sender, SelectionChangedEventArgs e)
        {
            ApplyFilters();
        }

        private void ClearFilters_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
        {
            SearchBox.Text = "Поиск по книге, читателю, группе...";
            SearchBox.Foreground = Brushes.Gray;
            _isPlaceholderActive = true;
            TypeFilterCombo.SelectedIndex = 0;
            StatusFilterCombo.SelectedIndex = 0;
            ApplyFilters();
        }

        private void FundMovementGrid_MouseDoubleClick(object sender, MouseButtonEventArgs e)
        {
            if (FundMovementGrid.SelectedItem is FundMovementItem selected)
            {
                if (selected.IssuanceType == "individual")
                {
                    // Переход на страницу читателя
                    NavigationService.Navigate(new Readers());
                }
                else
                {
                    // Для групповых выдач можно показать детали
                     CustomMessageBox.Show($"Групповая выдача\n" +
                                   $"Группа: {selected.GroupCode}\n" +
                                   $"Преподаватель: {selected.TeacherName}\n" +
                                   $"Студент: {selected.StudentName}\n" +
                                   $"Книг выдано: {selected.Quantity}\n" +
                                   $"Возвращено: {selected.ReturnedQuantity}",
                                   "Детали выдачи",
                                   CustomMessageBoxButton.OK,
                                   CustomMessageBoxImage.Information);
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

=== ФАЙЛ: ./Diplom_Bibl/Pages/ImportReaders.xaml.cs ===
﻿using Microsoft.Win32;
using System;
using System.IO;
using System.Text;
using System.Windows;
using System.Windows.Controls;
using ExcelDataReader;
using Diplom_Bibl.Controls;

namespace Diplom_Bibl.Pages
{
    public partial class ImportReaders : Page
    {
        private readonly string _connectionString = "Server=DMITRIJ;Database=DiplomBibl;Integrated Security=True;Encrypt=False;";

        public ImportReaders()
        {
            InitializeComponent();

            // Важно для поддержки русского языка в CSV
            Encoding.RegisterProvider(CodePagesEncodingProvider.Instance);
        }

        private void BrowseButton_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
        {
            OpenFileDialog openFileDialog = new OpenFileDialog
            {
                Filter = "Excel файлы|*.xlsx;*.xls|CSV файлы|*.csv|Все файлы|*.*",
                Title = "Выберите файл с данными читателей"
            };

            if (openFileDialog.ShowDialog() == true)
            {
                FilePathTextBox.Text = openFileDialog.FileName;
                ImportButton.IsEnabled = true;

                // Очищаем предыдущие результаты
                ClearResults();
            }
        }

        private async void ImportButton_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(FilePathTextBox.Text))
            {
                 CustomMessageBox.Show("Выберите файл для импорта.", "Ошибка",
                    CustomMessageBoxButton.OK, CustomMessageBoxImage.Warning);
                return;
            }

            if (!File.Exists(FilePathTextBox.Text))
            {
                 CustomMessageBox.Show("Файл не найден.", "Ошибка",
                    CustomMessageBoxButton.OK, CustomMessageBoxImage.Error);
                return;
            }

            try
            {
                // Блокируем кнопки
                ImportButton.IsEnabled = false;
                BrowseButton.IsEnabled = false;
                ImportButton.Content = "⏳ Импорт...";

                string filePath = FilePathTextBox.Text;
                string fileExtension = Path.GetExtension(filePath).ToLower();

                Services.ExcelImportService.ImportResult result = null;

                // Выполняем импорт в фоновом потоке
                result = await System.Threading.Tasks.Task.Run(() =>
                {
                    var service = new Services.ExcelImportService(_connectionString);

                    // Для CSV файлов используем специальную обработку
                    if (fileExtension == ".csv")
                    {
                        return service.ImportFromCsv(filePath);
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        return service.ImportFromFile(filePath);
                    }
                });

                // Отображаем результаты
                DisplayResults(result);
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                 CustomMessageBox.Show($"Ошибка при импорте: {ex.Message}\n\nПопробуйте сохранить файл в формате CSV.",
                    "Ошибка", CustomMessageBoxButton.OK, CustomMessageBoxImage.Error);
            }
            finally
            {
                // Разблокируем кнопки
                ImportButton.IsEnabled = true;
                BrowseButton.IsEnabled = true;
                ImportButton.Content = "📥 Импортировать";
            }
        }

        private void DisplayResults(Services.ExcelImportService.ImportResult result)
        {
            TotalRowsText.Text = result.TotalRows.ToString();
            SuccessRowsText.Text = result.SuccessRows.ToString();
            ErrorRowsText.Text = result.ErrorRows.ToString();

            if (result.Errors.Count > 0)
            {
                ErrorsListBox.ItemsSource = result.Errors;
                ErrorsListBox.Visibility = Visibility.Visible;
            }
            else
            {
                ErrorsListBox.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
            }

            if (result.Warnings.Count > 0)
            {
                WarningsListBox.ItemsSource = result.Warnings;
                WarningsListBox.Visibility = Visibility.Visible;
            }
            else
            {
                WarningsListBox.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
            }

            string message = result.HasErrors
                ? $"Импорт завершен с ошибками.\nУспешно: {result.SuccessRows}, Ошибок: {result.ErrorRows}"
                : $"Импорт успешно завершен!\nДобавлено читателей: {result.SuccessRows}";

             CustomMessageBox.Show(message, "Результат импорта",
                CustomMessageBoxButton.OK,
                result.HasErrors ? CustomMessageBoxImage.Warning : CustomMessageBoxImage.Information);
        }

        private void ClearResults()
        {
            TotalRowsText.Text = "0";
            SuccessRowsText.Text = "0";
            ErrorRowsText.Text = "0";
            ErrorsListBox.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
            WarningsListBox.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
        }

        private void DownloadTemplateButton_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
        {
            SaveFileDialog saveFileDialog = new SaveFileDialog
            {
                Filter = "CSV файл|*.csv",
                Title = "Сохранить шаблон",
                FileName = "Шаблон_импорта_читателей.csv"
            };

            if (saveFileDialog.ShowDialog() == true)
            {
                CreateCsvTemplate(saveFileDialog.FileName);
            }
        }

        private void CreateCsvTemplate(string filePath)
        {
            try
            {
                var template = new StringBuilder();

                // Русские заголовки
                template.AppendLine("Номер читательского билета,Фамилия,Имя,Отчество,Тип читателя,Группа,Должность,Специальность,Телефон,Домашний адрес,Дата начала членства,Дата оформления");

                // Пример данных (студент)
                template.AppendLine("001,Иванов,Иван,Иванович,Студент,ИС-121п,,09.02.07 Информационные системы и программирование,\"+7 (999) 123-45-67\",\"г Москва ул Ленина д 1\",01.09.2024,01.09.2024");

                // Пример данных (сотрудник)
                template.AppendLine("002,Петров,Петр,Петрович,Сотрудник,,Библиотекарь,Высшее образование,\"+7 (999) 765-43-21\",\"г Москва ул Мира д 10\",15.01.2020,15.01.2020");

                // Пример с минимальными данными
                template.AppendLine("003,Сидоров,Сидор,,Студент,ИС-122п,,,,,,");

                File.WriteAllText(filePath, template.ToString(), Encoding.UTF8);

                 CustomMessageBox.Show($"CSV шаблон сохранён:\n{filePath}\n\n" +
                               "Заполните данные и сохраните файл.\n\n" +
                               "💡 Подсказка: Для Excel откройте этот CSV файл и сохраните как XLSX.",
                    "Шаблон создан", CustomMessageBoxButton.OK, CustomMessageBoxImage.Information);
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                 CustomMessageBox.Show($"Ошибка при создании шаблона: {ex.Message}",
                    "Ошибка", CustomMessageBoxButton.OK, CustomMessageBoxImage.Error);
            }
        }

        private void Page_Loaded(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
        {
            ClearResults();
        }
    }
}

        public class RequestBookItem
        {

        public InformationServicePage()
        {
            InitializeComponent();

            _issuanceService = new BookIssuanceService(_connectionString);

            // Инициализируем коллекции
            _readers = new ObservableCollection<BookIssuanceService.ReaderInfo>();
            _students = new ObservableCollection<BookIssuanceService.ReaderInfo>();
            _groups = new ObservableCollection<BookIssuanceService.GroupInfo>();
            _teachers = new ObservableCollection<BookIssuanceService.TeacherInfo>();
            _books = new ObservableCollection<BookIssuanceService.BookInfo>();
            _todayIssues = new ObservableCollection<BookIssuanceService.IssuanceItem>();

            DatePicker.SelectedDate = DateTime.Today;

            // Загружаем данные
            LoadTodayIssues();
            LoadReaders();
            LoadGroups();
            LoadTeachers();
            LoadBooks();
            InitializeStats();
            LoadStatusIds();

            // Подписываемся на события
            this.Loaded += (s, e) => UpdateInventoryPreview();
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Устанавливает данные из заявки для автоматического заполнения
        /// </summary>
        public void SetDataFromRequest(int requestId, int userId, int? groupId, string userName, string groupCode, string lessonName, DateTime lessonDate)
        {
            _pendingRequestId = requestId;  // Это важно!
            _pendingUserId = userId;
            _pendingGroupId = groupId;
            _pendingUserName = userName;
            _pendingGroupCode = groupCode;
            _pendingLessonName = lessonName;
            _pendingLessonDate = lessonDate;
            _pendingUserTypeId = null;
        }

        private void LoadStatusIds()
        {
            try
            {
                using (var conn = new SqlConnection(_connectionString))
                {
                    conn.Open();

                    string availableQuery = "SELECT ID_Status FROM StatusBook WHERE Title_Status LIKE '%В наличии%'";
                    using (var cmd = new SqlCommand(availableQuery, conn))
                    {
                        var result = cmd.ExecuteScalar();
                        if (result != null)
                            _statusAvailableId = Convert.ToInt32(result);
                    }

                    string issuedQuery = "SELECT ID_Status FROM StatusBook WHERE Title_Status LIKE '%Выдана%'";
                    using (var cmd = new SqlCommand(issuedQuery, conn))
                    {
                        var result = cmd.ExecuteScalar();
                        if (result != null)
                            _statusIssuedId = Convert.ToInt32(result);
                    }
                }
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                System.Diagnostics.Debug.WriteLine($"Ошибка загрузки статусов: {ex.Message}");
            }
        }

        private void LoadTodayStats()
        {
            try
            {
                DateTime selectedDate = DatePicker.SelectedDate ?? DateTime.Today;

                using (var conn = new SqlConnection(_connectionString))
                {
                    conn.Open();

                    string query = @"
                SELECT id_record, delivery_book, delivery_certificate, events_count 
                FROM InformationServiseTb 
                WHERE date_record = @Date";

                    using (var cmd = new SqlCommand(query, conn))
                    {
                        cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@Date", selectedDate.Date);
                        using (var reader = cmd.ExecuteReader())
                        {
                            if (reader.Read())
                            {
                                _currentRecordId = Convert.ToInt32(reader["id_record"]);
                                BooksCountBox.Text = reader["delivery_book"].ToString();
                                ReferencesCountBox.Text = reader["delivery_certificate"].ToString();
                                EventsCountBox.Text = reader["events_count"].ToString();

                                SaveNewRecordButton.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
                                SaveChangesButton.Visibility = Visibility.Visible;
                                DeleteButton.Visibility = Visibility.Visible;
                            }
                            else
                            {
                                _currentRecordId = null;
                                SaveNewRecordButton.Visibility = Visibility.Visible;
                                SaveChangesButton.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
                                DeleteButton.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
                            }
                        }
                    }

                    UpdateStatsDisplay();
                }
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                CustomMessageBox.Show($"Ошибка загрузки статистики: {ex.Message}", "Ошибка", CustomMessageBoxButton.OK, CustomMessageBoxImage.Error);
            }
        }

        private void UpdateStatsDisplay()
        {
            if (BooksCountStat != null)
                BooksCountStat.Text = BooksCountBox.Text;
            if (ReferencesCountStat != null)
                ReferencesCountStat.Text = ReferencesCountBox.Text;
            if (EventsCountStat != null)
                EventsCountStat.Text = EventsCountBox.Text;
            if (IdRecordLabel != null)
                IdRecordLabel.Content = _currentRecordId.HasValue ? $"ID записи: {_currentRecordId}" : "Новая запись";
        }

        private void LoadReaders()
        {
            try
            {
                _readers = _issuanceService.GetReaders();
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                CustomMessageBox.Show($"Ошибка загрузки читателей: {ex.Message}", "Ошибка", CustomMessageBoxButton.OK, CustomMessageBoxImage.Error);
            }
        }

        private void LoadGroups()

            catch (Exception ex)

            }
        }

        private void LoadTeachers()
        {
            try
            {
                _teachers = _issuanceService.GetTeachers();
                System.Diagnostics.Debug.WriteLine($"Загружено преподавателей: {_teachers.Count}");
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                CustomMessageBox.Show($"Ошибка загрузки преподавателей: {ex.Message}", "Ошибка", CustomMessageBoxButton.OK, CustomMessageBoxImage.Error);
                _teachers = new ObservableCollection<BookIssuanceService.TeacherInfo>();
            }
        }

        private void LoadBooks()
        {
            try

            }
            catch (Exception ex)

            }
        }

        private void LoadTodayIssues()
        {
            try
            {
                _todayIssues = _issuanceService.GetIssuancesByDate(DateTime.Today);

                foreach (var item in _todayIssues)
                {
                    item.OverdueColor = item.IsOverdue ?
                        new SolidColorBrush((Color)ColorConverter.ConvertFromString("#DC3545")) :
                        new SolidColorBrush((Color)ColorConverter.ConvertFromString("#28A745"));
                }

                IssuesDataGrid.ItemsSource = _todayIssues;
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                CustomMessageBox.Show($"Ошибка загрузки выдач: {ex.Message}", "Ошибка", CustomMessageBoxButton.OK, CustomMessageBoxImage.Error);
            }
        }

        private void UpdateInventoryPreview()
        {
            try
            {
                if (QuantityBox == null || AvailableQuantityText == null || _selectedBook == null)
                    return;

                AvailableQuantityText.Text = _selectedBook.AvailableCopies.ToString();

                if (GroupTypeRadio.IsChecked == true)
                {
                    QuantityBox.IsEnabled = true;
                    if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(QuantityBox.Text) || QuantityBox.Text == "0")
                        QuantityBox.Text = "1";
                }
                else
                {
                    QuantityBox.Text = "1";
                    QuantityBox.IsEnabled = false;
                }
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                System.Diagnostics.Debug.WriteLine($"Ошибка в UpdateInventoryPreview: {ex.Message}");
            }
        }

        private void IssueType_Checked(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
        {
            try
            {
                if (ReaderTypeRadio.IsChecked == true)
                {
                    if (ReaderSearchSection != null)
                        ReaderSearchSection.Visibility = Visibility.Visible;
                    if (GroupSearchSection != null)
                        GroupSearchSection.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
                    if (QuantityBox != null)
                    {
                        QuantityBox.Text = "1";
                        QuantityBox.IsEnabled = false;
                    }
                }
                else
                {
                    if (ReaderSearchSection != null)
                        ReaderSearchSection.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
                    if (GroupSearchSection != null)
                        GroupSearchSection.Visibility = Visibility.Visible;
                    if (QuantityBox != null && _selectedBook != null)
                    {
                        QuantityBox.IsEnabled = true;
                        QuantityBox.Text = "1";
                    }
                }
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                System.Diagnostics.Debug.WriteLine($"Ошибка в IssueType_Checked: {ex.Message}");
            }
        }

        private void DatePicker_SelectedDateChanged(object sender, SelectionChangedEventArgs e)

                UpdateStatsDisplay();

            }

        // Поиск читателей
        private void ReaderSearchBox_GotFocus(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
        {
            if (_isPlaceholderActive && ReaderSearchBox.Text == "Введите фамилию или номер билета...")
            {
                ReaderSearchBox.Text = "";
                ReaderSearchBox.Foreground = Brushes.Black;
                _isPlaceholderActive = false;
            }
        }

        private void ReaderSearchBox_LostFocus(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(ReaderSearchBox.Text))
            {
                ReaderSearchBox.Text = "Введите фамилию или номер билета...";
                ReaderSearchBox.Foreground = Brushes.Gray;
                _isPlaceholderActive = true;
                ReadersListBox.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
            }
        }

        private void ReaderSearchBox_TextChanged(object sender, TextChangedEventArgs e)
        {
            if (ReadersListBox == null) return;

            string search = ReaderSearchBox.Text.ToLower();
            if (_isPlaceholderActive || string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(search))
            {
                ReadersListBox.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
                return;
            }

            var filtered = _readers.Where(r =>
                r.LastName.ToLower().Contains(search) ||
                r.FirstName.ToLower().Contains(search) ||
                r.CardNumber.ToLower().Contains(search)).Take(10).ToList();

            if (filtered.Any())
            {
                ReadersListBox.ItemsSource = filtered;
                ReadersListBox.Visibility = Visibility.Visible;
            }
            else
            {
                ReadersListBox.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
            }
        }

        private void ReadersListBox_SelectionChanged(object sender, SelectionChangedEventArgs e)
        {
            if (ReadersListBox?.SelectedItem is BookIssuanceService.ReaderInfo selected)
            {
                _selectedReader = selected;
                ReaderSearchBox.Text = selected.DisplayInfo;
                ReaderSearchBox.Foreground = Brushes.Black;
                ReadersListBox.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
            }
        }
