        private void LoadBooks()
        {
            try
            {
                const string sql = @"
                    SELECT 
                        b.IDBook,
                        b.InventaryNumber,
                        b.TitleBook,
                        b.Author,
                        ISNULL(a.SurnameAuthor + ' ' + a.NameAuthor + ' ' + a.PatronymicAuthor, '') AS AuthorName,
                        b.YearPublishing,
                        b.PublishingHouse,
                        ISNULL(p.TitlePublishingHouse, '') AS PublishingHouseName,
                        b.Gener,
                        ISNULL(g.TitleGener, '') AS GenreName,
                        b.StatusBook,
                        ISNULL(s.Title_Status, 'Неизвестно') AS StatusName
                    FROM Books b
                    LEFT JOIN Authors a ON b.Author = a.ID_Autor
                    LEFT JOIN PublishingHouse p ON b.PublishingHouse = p.IDPublishingHouse
                    LEFT JOIN GenersBook g ON b.Gener = g.ID_Gener
                    LEFT JOIN StatusBook s ON b.StatusBook = s.ID_Status
                    ORDER BY b.TitleBook";

                var list = new ObservableCollection<BookItem>();
                var yearsSet = new HashSet<int>();

                using (var conn = new SqlConnection(_conn))
                {
                    conn.Open();
                    using (var cmd = new SqlCommand(sql, conn))
                    using (var reader = cmd.ExecuteReader())
                    {
                        while (reader.Read())
                        {
                            var book = new BookItem
                            {
                                IDBook = Convert.ToInt32(reader["IDBook"]),
                                InventaryNumber = reader["InventaryNumber"].ToString(),
                                TitleBook = reader["TitleBook"].ToString(),
                                AuthorName = reader["AuthorName"].ToString(),
                                AuthorID = reader["Author"] != DBNull.Value ? Convert.ToInt32(reader["Author"]) : (int?)null,
                                YearPublishing = Convert.ToInt32(reader["YearPublishing"]),
                                PublishingHouseName = reader["PublishingHouseName"].ToString(),
                                PublisherID = reader["PublishingHouse"] != DBNull.Value ? Convert.ToInt32(reader["PublishingHouse"]) : (int?)null,
                                GenreName = reader["GenreName"].ToString(),
                                GenreID = reader["Gener"] != DBNull.Value ? Convert.ToInt32(reader["Gener"]) : (int?)null,
                                StatusName = reader["StatusName"].ToString(),
                                StatusID = reader["StatusBook"] != DBNull.Value ? Convert.ToInt32(reader["StatusBook"]) : (int?)null
                            };

                            list.Add(book);

                            // Собираем уникальные годы
                            if (book.YearPublishing > 0)
                                yearsSet.Add(book.YearPublishing);
                        }
                    }
                }

                _allBooks = list;
                _filteredBooks = new ObservableCollection<BookItem>(_allBooks);
                DgBooks.ItemsSource = _filteredBooks;

                // Загружаем все фильтры
                LoadStatuses();
                LoadGenres();
                LoadPublishers();
                LoadAuthors();

                // Заполняем фильтр по годам
                LoadYearFilters(yearsSet.ToList());
                UpdateStatistics();
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                CustomMessageBox.Show($"Ошибка загрузки книг: {ex.Message}",
                   "Ошибка", CustomMessageBoxButton.OK, CustomMessageBoxImage.Error);
            }
        }

        private void LoadYearFilters(List<int> years)
        {
            FilterYearCombo.Items.Clear();
            FilterYearCombo.Items.Add(new ComboBoxItem { Content = "Все годы", IsSelected = true });

            foreach (var year in years.OrderByDescending(y => y))
            {
                FilterYearCombo.Items.Add(new ComboBoxItem { Content = year.ToString() });
            }

            FilterYearCombo.SelectedIndex = 0;
        }

        private void ApplyFilters()
        {
            if (_allBooks == null) return;

            string searchTerm = _isPlaceholderActive ? "" : TbSearch.Text?.Trim().ToLower() ?? "";

            // Получаем выбранные фильтры
            int selectedStatusId = GetSelectedId(FilterStatusCombo);
            int selectedGenreId = GetSelectedId(FilterGenreCombo);
            int selectedPublisherId = GetSelectedId(FilterPublisherCombo);
            int selectedAuthorId = GetSelectedId(FilterAuthorCombo);

            string yearFilter = "Все годы";
            if (FilterYearCombo.SelectedItem is ComboBoxItem yearItem)
            {
                yearFilter = yearItem.Content.ToString();
            }

            var filtered = _allBooks.AsEnumerable();

            // Применяем поиск
            if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(searchTerm))
            {
                filtered = filtered.Where(b =>
                    b.InventaryNumber.ToLower().Contains(searchTerm) ||
                    b.TitleBook.ToLower().Contains(searchTerm) ||
                    b.AuthorName.ToLower().Contains(searchTerm) ||
                    b.PublishingHouseName.ToLower().Contains(searchTerm) ||
                    b.GenreName.ToLower().Contains(searchTerm) ||
                    b.StatusName.ToLower().Contains(searchTerm) ||
                    b.YearPublishing.ToString().Contains(searchTerm)
                );
            }

            // Применяем фильтр по статусу
            if (selectedStatusId > 0)
            {
                filtered = filtered.Where(b => b.StatusID == selectedStatusId);
            }

            // Применяем фильтр по жанру
            if (selectedGenreId > 0)
            {
                filtered = filtered.Where(b => b.GenreID == selectedGenreId);
            }

            // Применяем фильтр по издательству
            if (selectedPublisherId > 0)
            {
                filtered = filtered.Where(b => b.PublisherID == selectedPublisherId);
            }

            // Применяем фильтр по автору
            if (selectedAuthorId > 0)
            {
                filtered = filtered.Where(b => b.AuthorID == selectedAuthorId);
            }

            // Применяем фильтр по году
            if (yearFilter != "Все годы" && int.TryParse(yearFilter, out int year))
            {
                filtered = filtered.Where(b => b.YearPublishing == year);
            }

            var resultList = filtered.ToList();

            _filteredBooks.Clear();
            foreach (var item in resultList)
            {
                _filteredBooks.Add(item);
            }

            // Обновляем счетчик результатов
            SearchCountLabel.Text = $"Найдено: {resultList.Count} из {_allBooks.Count}";
        }

        private int GetSelectedId(ComboBox comboBox)
        {
            if (comboBox.SelectedValue != null && int.TryParse(comboBox.SelectedValue.ToString(), out int id))
            {
                return id;
            }
            return 0;
        }

        private void UpdateStatistics()
        {
            if (_allBooks == null) return;

            TotalBooksCount.Text = _allBooks.Count.ToString();

            // Получаем ID статусов с правильными названиями из БД
            int availableStatusId = GetStatusIdByName("В наличии");
            int issuedStatusId = GetStatusIdByName("Выдан");
            int disposedStatusId = GetStatusIdByName("Списана (архив)");
            int lostStatusId = GetStatusIdByName("Утрачен");

            int availableCount = _allBooks.Count(b => b.StatusID == availableStatusId);
            int issuedCount = _allBooks.Count(b => b.StatusID == issuedStatusId);
            int disposedCount = _allBooks.Count(b => b.StatusID == disposedStatusId);
            int lostCount = _allBooks.Count(b => b.StatusID == lostStatusId);

            AvailableBooksCount.Text = availableCount.ToString();
            IssuedBooksCount.Text = issuedCount.ToString();
            // Можно добавить счетчик списанных + утраченных
            DisposedBooksCount.Text = (disposedCount + lostCount).ToString();

            System.Diagnostics.Debug.WriteLine($"Статистика: Всего={_allBooks.Count}, В наличии={availableCount}, Выдано={issuedCount}, Списано+Утрачено={disposedCount + lostCount}");
            System.Diagnostics.Debug.WriteLine($"ID статусов: В наличии={availableStatusId}, Выдан={issuedStatusId}, Списана (архив)={disposedStatusId}, Утрачен={lostStatusId}");
        }

        private int GetStatusIdByName(string statusName)
        {
            var status = _allStatuses.FirstOrDefault(s =>
                s.Title_Status != null && s.Title_Status.Trim().Equals(statusName, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase));
            return status?.ID_Status ?? 0;
        }

        private void TbSearch_TextChanged(object sender, TextChangedEventArgs e)
        {
            if (_isPlaceholderActive) return;
            ApplyFilters();
        }

        private void FilterCombo_SelectionChanged(object sender, SelectionChangedEventArgs e)
        {
            ApplyFilters();
        }

        private void ClearFiltersBtn_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
        {
            TbSearch.Text = "";
            FilterStatusCombo.SelectedIndex = 0;
            FilterGenreCombo.SelectedIndex = 0;
            FilterPublisherCombo.SelectedIndex = 0;
            FilterAuthorCombo.SelectedIndex = 0;
            FilterYearCombo.SelectedIndex = 0;
            SetSearchPlaceholder();
        }

        private void DgBooks_MouseDoubleClick(object sender, MouseButtonEventArgs e)
        {
            if (DgBooks.SelectedItem is BookItem selectedBook)
            {
                try
                {
                    Mouse.OverrideCursor = Cursors.Wait;
                    var addBookPage = new AddBook(selectedBook.IDBook);
                    NavigationService.Navigate(addBookPage);
                }
                catch (Exception ex)
                {
                    CustomMessageBox.Show($"Ошибка при открытии книги: {ex.Message}", "Ошибка",
                        CustomMessageBoxButton.OK, CustomMessageBoxImage.Error);
                }
                finally
                {
                    Mouse.OverrideCursor = null;
                }
            }
        }

        private void Page_Loaded(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
        {
            LoadBooks();
        }

        private void BulkAddBook_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
        {
            NavigationService.Navigate(new BulkAddBooks());
        }

        private void FundMovementBtn_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
        {
            NavigationService.Navigate(new FundMovementPage());
        }
    }

﻿using Diplom_Bibl.Controls;
using System;
using System.Collections.ObjectModel;
using System.Data.SqlClient;
using System.Linq;
using System.Windows;

namespace Diplom_Bibl.Pages
{
    public partial class MyRequestsPage : Page
    {
        private readonly string _connectionString = "Server=DMITRIJ;Database=DiplomBibl;Integrated Security=True;Encrypt=False;";
        private readonly int _readerId;
        private ObservableCollection<RequestItem> _allRequests;

        // Класс для отображения заявки
        public class RequestItem
        {
            public int ID_Request { get; set; }
            public string RequestNumber { get; set; } = "";
            public DateTime RequestDate { get; set; }
            public string LessonName { get; set; } = "";
            public DateTime LessonDate { get; set; }
            public string StatusName { get; set; } = "";
            public int TotalBooks { get; set; }
            public DateTime? ExpirationDate { get; set; }
            public string GroupCode { get; set; } = "";
            public int StatusID { get; set; }

            public SolidColorBrush StatusColor
            {
                get
                {
                    switch (StatusName)
                    {
                        case "Новая": return new SolidColorBrush((Color)ColorConverter.ConvertFromString("#3498DB"));
                        case "В обработке": return new SolidColorBrush((Color)ColorConverter.ConvertFromString("#F39C12"));
                        case "Готова": return new SolidColorBrush((Color)ColorConverter.ConvertFromString("#27AE60"));
                        case "Выдана": return new SolidColorBrush((Color)ColorConverter.ConvertFromString("#1ABC9C"));
                        case "Отменена": return new SolidColorBrush((Color)ColorConverter.ConvertFromString("#E74C3C"));
                        case "Просрочена": return new SolidColorBrush((Color)ColorConverter.ConvertFromString("#95A5A6"));
                        default: return new SolidColorBrush((Color)ColorConverter.ConvertFromString("#95A5A6"));
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        // Класс для книг в заявке
        public class RequestBookDetail
        {
            public string BookTitle { get; set; } = "";
            public string AuthorName { get; set; } = "";
            public int Quantity { get; set; }
            public string StatusName { get; set; } = "";
        }

        public MyRequestsPage(int readerId)
        {
            InitializeComponent();
            _readerId = readerId;
        }

        private async void Page_Loaded(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
        {
            await LoadRequests();
        }

        private async System.Threading.Tasks.Task LoadRequests()
        {
            try
            {
                string query = @"
                    SELECT 
                        r.ID_Request,
                        r.RequestNumber,
                        r.RequestDate,
                        r.LessonName,
                        r.LessonDate,
                        rs.StatusName,
                        rs.ID_Status AS StatusID,
                        (SELECT SUM(Quantity) FROM RequestItems WHERE RequestID = r.ID_Request) AS TotalBooks,
                        r.ExpirationDate,
                        g.GroupCode
                    FROM BookRequests r
                    LEFT JOIN Groups g ON r.GroupID = g.GroupID
                    LEFT JOIN RequestStatuses rs ON r.StatusID = rs.ID_Status
                    WHERE r.UserID = @ReaderId
                    ORDER BY r.RequestDate DESC";

                var requests = new ObservableCollection<RequestItem>();

                using (var conn = new SqlConnection(_connectionString))
                {
                    await conn.OpenAsync();
                    using (var cmd = new SqlCommand(query, conn))
                    {
                        cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@ReaderId", _readerId);
                        using (var reader = await cmd.ExecuteReaderAsync())
                        {
                            while (await reader.ReadAsync())
                            {
                                requests.Add(new RequestItem
                                {
                                    ID_Request = Convert.ToInt32(reader["ID_Request"]),
                                    RequestNumber = reader["RequestNumber"].ToString(),
                                    RequestDate = Convert.ToDateTime(reader["RequestDate"]),
                                    LessonName = reader["LessonName"].ToString(),
                                    LessonDate = Convert.ToDateTime(reader["LessonDate"]),
                                    StatusName = reader["StatusName"].ToString(),
                                    StatusID = Convert.ToInt32(reader["StatusID"]),
                                    TotalBooks = Convert.ToInt32(reader["TotalBooks"]),
                                    ExpirationDate = reader["ExpirationDate"] != DBNull.Value ? Convert.ToDateTime(reader["ExpirationDate"]) : (DateTime?)null,
                                    GroupCode = reader["GroupCode"]?.ToString() ?? ""
                                });
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }

                _allRequests = requests;
                DgRequests.ItemsSource = _allRequests;
                UpdateStatistics();
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                CustomMessageBox.Show($"Ошибка загрузки заявок: {ex.Message}", "Ошибка",
                    CustomMessageBoxButton.OK, CustomMessageBoxImage.Error);
            }
        }

        private void UpdateStatistics()
        {
            if (_allRequests == null) return;

            int total = _allRequests.Count;
            int active = _allRequests.Count(r => r.StatusName == "Новая" || r.StatusName == "В обработке");
            int ready = _allRequests.Count(r => r.StatusName == "Готова");
            int issued = _allRequests.Count(r => r.StatusName == "Выдана");

            // Можно добавить отображение статистики, если есть элементы в XAML
            // TbTotalCount.Text = total.ToString();
            // TbActiveCount.Text = active.ToString();
            // TbReadyCount.Text = ready.ToString();
            // TbIssuedCount.Text = issued.ToString();
        }

        private void ApplyFilters()
        {
            if (_allRequests == null) return;

            string searchTerm = TbSearch.Text?.Trim().ToLower() ?? "";
            string statusFilter = (CbStatusFilter.SelectedItem as ComboBoxItem)?.Content?.ToString() ?? "Все заявки";

            var filtered = _allRequests.AsEnumerable();

            if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(searchTerm))
            {
                filtered = filtered.Where(r =>
                    r.RequestNumber.ToLower().Contains(searchTerm) ||
                    r.LessonName.ToLower().Contains(searchTerm) ||
                    r.GroupCode.ToLower().Contains(searchTerm));
            }

            if (statusFilter != "Все заявки")
            {
                filtered = filtered.Where(r => r.StatusName == statusFilter);
            }

            DgRequests.ItemsSource = filtered.ToList();
        }

        private void TbSearch_TextChanged(object sender, TextChangedEventArgs e)
        {
            ApplyFilters();
        }

        private void CbStatusFilter_SelectionChanged(object sender, SelectionChangedEventArgs e)
        {
            ApplyFilters();
        }

        private async void ViewRequest_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
        {
            Button btn = sender as Button;
            if (btn != null && btn.Tag != null)
            {
                int requestId = (int)btn.Tag;
                await ShowRequestDetails(requestId);
            }
        }

        private void CloseDetailsPanel_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
        {
            DetailsPanel.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
            DgRequestItems.ItemsSource = null;
        }

        private async System.Threading.Tasks.Task ShowRequestDetails(int requestId)
        {
            try
            {
                string query = @"
                    SELECT 
                        r.RequestNumber,
                        r.LessonName,
                        r.LessonDate,
                        r.RequestDate,
                        g.GroupCode,
                        rs.StatusName,
                        r.ExpirationDate,
                        b.TitleBook,
                        ISNULL(a.SurnameAuthor + ' ' + a.NameAuthor + ' ' + a.PatronymicAuthor, '') AS AuthorName,
                        ri.Quantity,
                        ris.StatusName AS ItemStatusName
                    FROM BookRequests r
                    LEFT JOIN Groups g ON r.GroupID = g.GroupID
                    LEFT JOIN RequestStatuses rs ON r.StatusID = rs.ID_Status
                    LEFT JOIN RequestItems ri ON r.ID_Request = ri.RequestID
                    LEFT JOIN Books b ON ri.BookID = b.IDBook
                    LEFT JOIN Authors a ON b.Author = a.ID_Autor
                    LEFT JOIN RequestItemStatuses ris ON ri.StatusID = ris.ID_Status
                    WHERE r.ID_Request = @RequestId";

                var items = new ObservableCollection<RequestBookDetail>();

                using (var conn = new SqlConnection(_connectionString))
                {
                    await conn.OpenAsync();
                    using (var cmd = new SqlCommand(query, conn))
                    {
                        cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@RequestId", requestId);
                        using (var reader = await cmd.ExecuteReaderAsync())
                        {
                            bool hasData = false;

                            while (await reader.ReadAsync())
                            {
                                if (!hasData)
                                {
                                    Dispatcher.Invoke(() =>
                                    {
                                        TbRequestNumber.Text = $"Заявка №: {reader["RequestNumber"]}";
                                        TbLessonInfo.Text = $"Занятие: {reader["LessonName"]}";
                                        TbRequestDate.Text = $"Дата создания: {Convert.ToDateTime(reader["RequestDate"]):dd.MM.yyyy HH:mm}";
                                        TbGroupInfo.Text = $"Группа: {reader["GroupCode"]?.ToString() ?? "Не указана"}";
                                        TbStatus.Text = $"Статус: {reader["StatusName"]}";
                                        if (reader["ExpirationDate"] != DBNull.Value)
                                            TbExpirationDate.Text = $"Срок брони: {Convert.ToDateTime(reader["ExpirationDate"]):dd.MM.yyyy}";
                                        else
                                            TbExpirationDate.Text = "";
                                    });
                                    hasData = true;
                                }

                                if (reader["TitleBook"] != DBNull.Value)
                                {
                                    items.Add(new RequestBookDetail
                                    {
                                        BookTitle = reader["TitleBook"].ToString(),
                                        AuthorName = reader["AuthorName"].ToString(),
                                        Quantity = Convert.ToInt32(reader["Quantity"]),
                                        StatusName = reader["ItemStatusName"]?.ToString() ?? "Неизвестен"
                                    });
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }

                DgRequestItems.ItemsSource = items;
                DetailsPanel.Visibility = Visibility.Visible;

                if (items.Count == 0)
                {
                    var emptyList = new ObservableCollection<RequestBookDetail>();
                    emptyList.Add(new RequestBookDetail
                    {
                        BookTitle = "Нет книг в заявке",
                        AuthorName = "",
                        Quantity = 0,
                        StatusName = ""
                    });
                    DgRequestItems.ItemsSource = emptyList;
                }
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                CustomMessageBox.Show($"Ошибка загрузки деталей: {ex.Message}", "Ошибка",
                    CustomMessageBoxButton.OK, CustomMessageBoxImage.Error);
            }
        }

        private void DgRequests_SelectionChanged(object sender, SelectionChangedEventArgs e)
        {
            if (DgRequests.SelectedItem is RequestItem selected)
            {
                _ = ShowRequestDetails(selected.ID_Request);
            }
        }
    }
}

﻿using Dadata.Model;
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Collections.ObjectModel;
using System.Data.SqlClient;
using System.Linq;
using System.Windows;
using System.Windows.Controls;
using System.Windows.Input;
using System.Windows.Media;
using Diplom_Bibl.Controls;

namespace Diplom_Bibl.Pages
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Логика взаимодействия для Readers.xaml
    /// </summary>
    public partial class Readers : Page
    {
        private string connectionString = "Server=DMITRIJ;Database=DiplomBibl;Integrated Security=True;Encrypt=False;MultipleActiveResultSets=True;";
        private ObservableCollection<ReaderDisplayItem> _allReaders;
        private ObservableCollection<ReaderDisplayItem> _filteredReaders;
        private int? _currentReaderId = null;

        // Класс для отображения читателя в списке
        public class ReaderDisplayItem
        {
            public int ReaderID { get; set; }
            public string CardNumber { get; set; } = "";
            public string LastName { get; set; } = "";
            public string FirstName { get; set; } = "";
            public string MiddleName { get; set; } = "";
            public int TypeID { get; set; }
            public string TypeName { get; set; } = "";
            public int? GroupID { get; set; }
            public string GroupCode { get; set; } = "";
            public int? PostID { get; set; }
            public string PostName { get; set; } = "";
            public string Speciality { get; set; } = "";
            public string PhoneNumber { get; set; } = "";
            public string HomeAddress { get; set; } = "";
            public DateTime MembershipStartDate { get; set; }
            public DateTime FormFillDate { get; set; }

            public string FullName => $"{LastName} {FirstName} {MiddleName}".Trim();
            public string Initials => GetInitials();
            public string MembershipDateString => MembershipStartDate.ToString("dd.MM.yyyy");
            public string GroupOrPostInfo => GetGroupOrPostInfo();

            private string GetInitials()
            {
                string initials = LastName;
                if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(FirstName))
                    initials += $" {FirstName[0]}.";
                if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(MiddleName))
                    initials += $" {MiddleName[0]}.";
                return initials;
            }

            private string GetGroupOrPostInfo()
            {
                if (TypeName?.ToLower().Contains("студент") == true && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(GroupCode))
                    return $"Группа: {GroupCode}";
                if (TypeName?.ToLower().Contains("сотрудник") == true && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(PostName))
                    return $"Должность: {PostName}";
                return "";
            }
        }

        // Класс для фильтрации по типу
        public class FilterTypeItem
        {
            public int TypeID { get; set; }
            public string DisplayName { get; set; } = "";
        }

        // Класс для фильтрации по группе
        public class FilterGroupItem
        {
            public int GroupID { get; set; }
            public string GroupCode { get; set; } = "";
        }

        // Класс для фильтрации по должности
        public class FilterPostItem
        {
            public int PostID { get; set; }
            public string PostName { get; set; } = "";
        }

        public Readers()
        {
            InitializeComponent();
        }

        private void Page_Loaded(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
        {
            LoadFilterData();
            LoadReaders();
        }

        private void LoadFilterData()
        {
            try
            {
                // Загружаем типы читателей для фильтра
                using (var connection = new SqlConnection(connectionString))
                {
                    connection.Open();

                    // Загружаем типы
                    var typeQuery = "SELECT TypeID, TypeName FROM ReaderType ORDER BY TypeName";
                    using (var cmd = new SqlCommand(typeQuery, connection))
                    using (var reader = cmd.ExecuteReader())
                    {
                        var types = new ObservableCollection<FilterTypeItem>();
                        types.Add(new FilterTypeItem { TypeID = 0, DisplayName = "Все типы" });

                        while (reader.Read())
                        {
                            types.Add(new FilterTypeItem
                            {
                                TypeID = Convert.ToInt32(reader["TypeID"]),
                                DisplayName = reader["TypeName"]?.ToString() ?? ""
                            });
                        }

                        FilterTypeCombo.ItemsSource = types;
                        FilterTypeCombo.SelectedValuePath = "TypeID";
                        FilterTypeCombo.DisplayMemberPath = "DisplayName";
                        FilterTypeCombo.SelectedIndex = 0;
                    }
                }

                // Загружаем группы для фильтра
                LoadGroupsForFilter();

                // Загружаем должности для фильтра
                LoadPostsForFilter();
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                CustomMessageBox.Show($"Ошибка загрузки данных для фильтров: {ex.Message}",
                    "Ошибка", CustomMessageBoxButton.OK, CustomMessageBoxImage.Error);
            }
        }

        private void LoadGroupsForFilter()
        {
            try
            {
                const string query = "SELECT GroupID, GroupCode FROM Groups ORDER BY GroupCode";
                using (var connection = new SqlConnection(connectionString))
                {
                    connection.Open();
                    using (var cmd = new SqlCommand(query, connection))
                    using (var reader = cmd.ExecuteReader())
                    {
                        var groups = new ObservableCollection<FilterGroupItem>();
                        groups.Add(new FilterGroupItem { GroupID = 0, GroupCode = "Все группы" });

                        while (reader.Read())
                        {
                            groups.Add(new FilterGroupItem
                            {
                                GroupID = Convert.ToInt32(reader["GroupID"]),
                                GroupCode = reader["GroupCode"]?.ToString() ?? ""
                            });
                        }

                        FilterGroupCombo.ItemsSource = groups;
                        FilterGroupCombo.SelectedValuePath = "GroupID";
                        FilterGroupCombo.DisplayMemberPath = "GroupCode";
                        FilterGroupCombo.SelectedIndex = 0;
                    }
                }
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                CustomMessageBox.Show($"Ошибка загрузки групп: {ex.Message}",
                    "Ошибка", CustomMessageBoxButton.OK, CustomMessageBoxImage.Error);
            }
        }

        private void LoadPostsForFilter()
        {
            try
            {
                const string query = "SELECT ID_Post, Post_Name FROM Post ORDER BY Post_Name";
                using (var connection = new SqlConnection(connectionString))
                {
                    connection.Open();
                    using (var cmd = new SqlCommand(query, connection))
                    using (var reader = cmd.ExecuteReader())
                    {
                        var posts = new ObservableCollection<FilterPostItem>();
                        posts.Add(new FilterPostItem { PostID = 0, PostName = "Все должности" });

                        while (reader.Read())
                        {
                            posts.Add(new FilterPostItem
                            {
                                PostID = Convert.ToInt32(reader["ID_Post"]),
                                PostName = reader["Post_Name"]?.ToString() ?? ""
                            });
                        }

                        FilterPostCombo.ItemsSource = posts;
                        FilterPostCombo.SelectedValuePath = "PostID";
                        FilterPostCombo.DisplayMemberPath = "PostName";
                        FilterPostCombo.SelectedIndex = 0;
                    }
                }
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                CustomMessageBox.Show($"Ошибка загрузки должностей: {ex.Message}",
                    "Ошибка", CustomMessageBoxButton.OK, CustomMessageBoxImage.Error);
            }
        }

        private void LoadReaders()
        {
            try
            {
                const string query = @"
            SELECT 
                r.ReaderID, r.CardNumber, r.LastName, r.FirstName, r.MiddleName,
                r.TypeID, rt.TypeName,
                r.GroupID, g.GroupCode,
                r.Post, p.Post_Name,
                r.Speciality, r.PhoneNumber, r.HomeAddress,
                r.MembershipStartDate, r.FormFillDate
            FROM ReaderForm r
            LEFT JOIN ReaderType rt ON r.TypeID = rt.TypeID
            LEFT JOIN Groups g ON r.GroupID = g.GroupID
            LEFT JOIN Post p ON r.Post = p.ID_Post
            ORDER BY r.LastName, r.FirstName";

                using (var connection = new SqlConnection(connectionString))
                {
                    connection.Open();
                    using (var command = new SqlCommand(query, connection))
                    using (var reader = command.ExecuteReader())
                    {
                        var items = new ObservableCollection<ReaderDisplayItem>();

                        while (reader.Read())
                        {
                            items.Add(new ReaderDisplayItem
                            {
                                ReaderID = reader["ReaderID"] != DBNull.Value ? Convert.ToInt32(reader["ReaderID"]) : 0,
                                CardNumber = reader["CardNumber"]?.ToString() ?? "",
                                LastName = reader["LastName"]?.ToString() ?? "",
                                FirstName = reader["FirstName"]?.ToString() ?? "",
                                MiddleName = reader["MiddleName"]?.ToString() ?? "",
                                TypeID = reader["TypeID"] != DBNull.Value ? Convert.ToInt32(reader["TypeID"]) : 0,
                                TypeName = reader["TypeName"]?.ToString() ?? "",
                                GroupID = reader["GroupID"] != DBNull.Value ? Convert.ToInt32(reader["GroupID"]) : (int?)null,
                                GroupCode = reader["GroupCode"]?.ToString() ?? "",
                                PostID = reader["Post"] != DBNull.Value ? Convert.ToInt32(reader["Post"]) : (int?)null,
                                PostName = reader["Post_Name"]?.ToString() ?? "",
                                Speciality = reader["Speciality"]?.ToString() ?? "",
                                PhoneNumber = reader["PhoneNumber"]?.ToString() ?? "",
                                HomeAddress = reader["HomeAddress"]?.ToString() ?? "",
                                MembershipStartDate = reader["MembershipStartDate"] != DBNull.Value ? Convert.ToDateTime(reader["MembershipStartDate"]) : DateTime.Now,
                                FormFillDate = reader["FormFillDate"] != DBNull.Value ? Convert.ToDateTime(reader["FormFillDate"]) : DateTime.Now
                            });
                        }

                        _allReaders = items;
                        ApplyFilters(); // Применяем фильтры при загрузке
                        UpdateStatistics();
                    }
                }
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                CustomMessageBox.Show($"Ошибка загрузки читателей: {ex.Message}",
                    "Ошибка", CustomMessageBoxButton.OK, CustomMessageBoxImage.Error);
            }
        }

        private void ApplyFilters()
        {
            if (_allReaders == null) return;

            var filtered = _allReaders.AsEnumerable();

            // Фильтр по тексту поиска
            string searchTerm = SearchBox.Text?.Trim() ?? "";
            if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(searchTerm) && searchTerm != "Поиск по фамилии или номеру билета...")
            {
                filtered = filtered.Where(r =>
                    r.LastName.ToLower().Contains(searchTerm.ToLower()) ||
                    r.FirstName.ToLower().Contains(searchTerm.ToLower()) ||
                    r.CardNumber.ToLower().Contains(searchTerm.ToLower()));
            }

            // Фильтр по типу читателя
            if (FilterTypeCombo.SelectedItem is FilterTypeItem selectedType && selectedType.TypeID > 0)
            {
                filtered = filtered.Where(r => r.TypeID == selectedType.TypeID);
            }

            // Фильтр по группе (только для студентов)
            if (FilterGroupCombo.SelectedItem is FilterGroupItem selectedGroup && selectedGroup.GroupID > 0)
            {
                // Проверяем, что выбран тип "Студент" или "Все типы"
                int? selectedTypeId = (FilterTypeCombo.SelectedItem as FilterTypeItem)?.TypeID;
                bool isStudentSelected = selectedTypeId == null || selectedTypeId == 0;

                // Если не выбран конкретный тип, фильтруем только студентов с этой группой
                if (isStudentSelected)
                {
                    filtered = filtered.Where(r => r.GroupID == selectedGroup.GroupID);
                }
                else
                {
                    filtered = filtered.Where(r => r.GroupID == selectedGroup.GroupID);
                }
            }

            // Фильтр по должности (только для сотрудников)
            if (FilterPostCombo.SelectedItem is FilterPostItem selectedPost && selectedPost.PostID > 0)
            {
                filtered = filtered.Where(r => r.PostID == selectedPost.PostID);
            }

            _filteredReaders = new ObservableCollection<ReaderDisplayItem>(filtered);
            ReadersListView.ItemsSource = _filteredReaders;

            // Обновляем счетчик результатов поиска
            UpdateSearchCount();
        }

        private void UpdateSearchCount()
        {
            int count = _filteredReaders?.Count ?? 0;
            SearchCountLabel.Text = $"Найдено: {count}";
        }

        private void UpdateStatistics()
        {
            if (_allReaders == null) return;

            TotalReadersCount.Text = _allReaders.Count.ToString();
            StudentsCount.Text = _allReaders.Count(r => r.TypeName?.ToLower().Contains("студент") == true).ToString();
            EmployeesCount.Text = _allReaders.Count(r => r.TypeName?.ToLower().Contains("сотрудник") == true).ToString();
        }

        private void SearchBox_TextChanged(object sender, TextChangedEventArgs e)
        {
            ApplyFilters();
        }

        private void SearchBox_GotFocus(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
        {
            if (SearchBox.Text == "Поиск по фамилии или номеру билета...")
            {
                SearchBox.Text = "";
                SearchBox.Foreground = Brushes.Black;
            }
        }

        private void SearchBox_LostFocus(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(SearchBox.Text))
            {
                SearchBox.Text = "Поиск по фамилии или номеру билета...";
                SearchBox.Foreground = Brushes.Gray;
            }
        }

        private void FilterCombo_SelectionChanged(object sender, SelectionChangedEventArgs e)
        {
            ApplyFilters();
        }

        private void ClearFiltersBtn_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
        {
            FilterTypeCombo.SelectedIndex = 0;
            FilterGroupCombo.SelectedIndex = 0;
            FilterPostCombo.SelectedIndex = 0;
            SearchBox.Text = "";
            ApplyFilters();
        }

        private void AddReader_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
        {
            NavigationService?.Navigate(new AddReader());
        }

        private void ImportReadersBtn_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
        {
            NavigationService?.Navigate(new ImportReaders());
            //// Импорт из Excel
            //CustomMessageBox.Show("Функция импорта из Excel будет добавлена позже.",
            //    "Информация", CustomMessageBoxButton.OK, CustomMessageBoxImage.Information);
        }

        private void ReadersListView_MouseDoubleClick(object sender, MouseButtonEventArgs e)
        {
            if (ReadersListView.SelectedItem is ReaderDisplayItem selectedReader)
            {
                NavigationService?.Navigate(new AddReader(selectedReader.ReaderID));
            }
        }
    }
}

        private ObservableCollection<BookIssuanceReport> LoadBookIssuanceReport(DateTime start, DateTime end)
        {
            var data = new ObservableCollection<BookIssuanceReport>();

            string query = @"
                SELECT 
                    i.IssuanceDate,
                    b.TitleBook,
                    b.InventaryNumber,
                    CONCAT(r.LastName, ' ', r.FirstName, ' ', ISNULL(r.MiddleName, '')) AS ReaderName,
                    CASE 
                        WHEN rt.TypeName = 'Студент' THEN ISNULL(g.GroupCode, '')
                        WHEN rt.TypeName = 'Сотрудник' THEN ISNULL(p.Post_Name, '')
                        ELSE ''
                    END AS GroupOrPost,
                    i.PlannedReturnDate,
                    i.ReturnDate,
                    i.Status,
                    CASE 
                        WHEN i.ReturnDate IS NULL AND i.PlannedReturnDate < GETDATE() 
                        THEN DATEDIFF(DAY, i.PlannedReturnDate, GETDATE())
                        WHEN i.ReturnDate > i.PlannedReturnDate
                        THEN DATEDIFF(DAY, i.PlannedReturnDate, i.ReturnDate)
                        ELSE 0
                    END AS DaysOverdue
                FROM BookIssuance i
                INNER JOIN Books b ON i.BookId = b.IDBook
                INNER JOIN ReaderForm r ON i.ReaderId = r.ReaderID
                INNER JOIN ReaderType rt ON r.TypeID = rt.TypeID
                LEFT JOIN Groups g ON r.GroupID = g.GroupID
                LEFT JOIN Post p ON r.Post = p.ID_Post
                WHERE CAST(i.IssuanceDate AS DATE) BETWEEN @StartDate AND @EndDate
                ORDER BY i.IssuanceDate DESC";

            try
            {
                using (SqlConnection conn = new SqlConnection(_connectionString))
                {
                    conn.Open();
                    using (SqlCommand cmd = new SqlCommand(query, conn))
                    {
                        cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@StartDate", start.Date);
                        cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@EndDate", end.Date);

                        using (SqlDataReader reader = cmd.ExecuteReader())
                        {
                            while (reader.Read())
                            {
                                var report = new BookIssuanceReport
                                {
                                    IssuanceDate = reader.GetDateTime(0),
                                    BookTitle = reader.GetString(1),
                                    InventoryNumber = reader.GetString(2),
                                    ReaderName = reader.GetString(3),
                                    GroupOrPost = reader.GetString(4),
                                    PlannedReturnDate = reader.GetDateTime(5),
                                    ReturnDate = reader.IsDBNull(6) ? (DateTime?)null : reader.GetDateTime(6),
                                    Status = reader.GetString(7),
                                    DaysOverdue = reader.GetInt32(8)
                                };
                                data.Add(report);
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                CustomMessageBox.Show($"Ошибка загрузки данных: {ex.Message}", "Ошибка",
                    CustomMessageBoxButton.OK, CustomMessageBoxImage.Error);
            }

            return data;
        }

        private ObservableCollection<ReaderActivityReport> LoadReaderActivityReport()
        {
            var data = new ObservableCollection<ReaderActivityReport>();

            string query = @"
                SELECT 
                    r.ReaderID,
                    r.CardNumber,
                    CONCAT(r.LastName, ' ', r.FirstName, ' ', ISNULL(r.MiddleName, '')) AS FullName,
                    rt.TypeName,
                    CASE 
                        WHEN rt.TypeName = 'Студент' THEN ISNULL(g.GroupCode, '')
                        WHEN rt.TypeName = 'Сотрудник' THEN ISNULL(p.Post_Name, '')
                        ELSE ''
                    END AS GroupOrPost,
                    COUNT(CASE WHEN i.Status = 'Возвращена' THEN 1 END) AS BooksReturned,
                    COUNT(CASE WHEN i.Status = 'Выдана' THEN 1 END) AS CurrentlyIssued,
                    SUM(CASE WHEN i.ReturnDate IS NULL AND i.PlannedReturnDate < GETDATE() THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS OverdueBooks,
                    MAX(i.IssuanceDate) AS LastIssuanceDate
                FROM ReaderForm r
                INNER JOIN ReaderType rt ON r.TypeID = rt.TypeID
                LEFT JOIN Groups g ON r.GroupID = g.GroupID
                LEFT JOIN Post p ON r.Post = p.ID_Post
                LEFT JOIN BookIssuance i ON r.ReaderID = i.ReaderId
                GROUP BY r.ReaderID, r.CardNumber, r.LastName, r.FirstName, r.MiddleName, 
                         rt.TypeName, g.GroupCode, p.Post_Name
                ORDER BY CurrentlyIssued DESC, BooksReturned DESC";

            try
            {
                using (SqlConnection conn = new SqlConnection(_connectionString))
                {
                    conn.Open();
                    using (SqlCommand cmd = new SqlCommand(query, conn))
                    using (SqlDataReader reader = cmd.ExecuteReader())
                    {
                        while (reader.Read())
                        {
                            int booksReturned = reader.GetInt32(5);
                            int currentlyIssued = reader.GetInt32(6);

                            var report = new ReaderActivityReport
                            {
                                ReaderID = reader.GetInt32(0),
                                CardNumber = reader.GetString(1),
                                FullName = reader.GetString(2),
                                TypeName = reader.GetString(3),
                                GroupOrPost = reader.GetString(4),
                                BooksReturned = booksReturned,
                                CurrentlyIssued = currentlyIssued,
                                OverdueBooks = reader.GetInt32(7),
                                LastIssuanceDate = reader.IsDBNull(8) ? (DateTime?)null : reader.GetDateTime(8),
                                BooksIssued = booksReturned + currentlyIssued
                            };
                            data.Add(report);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                CustomMessageBox.Show($"Ошибка загрузки данных: {ex.Message}", "Ошибка",
                    CustomMessageBoxButton.OK, CustomMessageBoxImage.Error);
            }

            return data;
        }

        private ObservableCollection<BookFundGroupedReport> LoadBookFundReportGrouped()
        {
            var data = new ObservableCollection<BookFundGroupedReport>();

            string query = @"
                SELECT 
                    b.TitleBook,
                    MAX(CONCAT(a.SurnameAuthor, ' ', a.NameAuthor, ' ', ISNULL(a.PatronymicAuthor, ''))) AS AuthorName,
                    MAX(ISNULL(ph.TitlePublishingHouse, '')) AS Publisher,
                    MAX(b.YearPublishing) AS Year,
                    MAX(ISNULL(g.TitleGener, '')) AS Genre,
                    SUM(b.TotalCopies) AS TotalCopies,
                    SUM(b.AvailableCopies) AS AvailableCopies,
                    SUM(b.CopiesInUse) AS CopiesInUse
                FROM Books b
                INNER JOIN Authors a ON b.Author = a.ID_Autor
                LEFT JOIN PublishingHouse ph ON b.PublishingHouse = ph.IDPublishingHouse
                LEFT JOIN GenersBook g ON b.Gener = g.ID_Gener
                GROUP BY b.TitleBook
                ORDER BY b.TitleBook";

            try
            {
                using (SqlConnection conn = new SqlConnection(_connectionString))
                {
                    conn.Open();
                    using (SqlCommand cmd = new SqlCommand(query, conn))
                    using (SqlDataReader reader = cmd.ExecuteReader())
                    {
                        while (reader.Read())
                        {
                            var report = new BookFundGroupedReport
                            {
                                Title = reader.GetString(0),
                                AuthorName = reader.GetString(1),
                                Publisher = reader.GetString(2),
                                Year = reader.GetInt32(3),
                                Genre = reader.GetString(4),
                                TotalCopies = reader.GetInt32(5),
                                AvailableCopies = reader.GetInt32(6),
                                CopiesInUse = reader.GetInt32(7)
                            };
                            data.Add(report);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                CustomMessageBox.Show($"Ошибка загрузки данных: {ex.Message}", "Ошибка",
                    CustomMessageBoxButton.OK, CustomMessageBoxImage.Error);
            }

            return data;
        }

        private ObservableCollection<InfoServiceReport> LoadInfoServiceReport(DateTime start, DateTime end)
        {
            var data = new ObservableCollection<InfoServiceReport>();
            string query = @"
                SELECT id_record, date_record, delivery_book, delivery_certificate, events_count 
                FROM InformationServiseTb 
                WHERE date_record BETWEEN @StartDate AND @EndDate 
                ORDER BY date_record, id_record";

            try
            {
                using (SqlConnection connection = new SqlConnection(_connectionString))
                {
                    connection.Open();
                    using (SqlCommand command = new SqlCommand(query, connection))
                    {
                        command.Parameters.AddWithValue("@StartDate", start.Date);
                        command.Parameters.AddWithValue("@EndDate", end.Date);

                        using (SqlDataReader reader = command.ExecuteReader())
                        {
                            while (reader.Read())
                            {
                                var report = new InfoServiceReport
                                {
                                    IdRecord = reader.GetInt32(0),
                                    DateRecord = reader.GetDateTime(1),
                                    DeliveryBook = reader.GetInt32(2),
                                    DeliveryCertificate = reader.GetInt32(3),
                                    EventsCount = reader.GetInt32(4)
                                };
                                data.Add(report);
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                CustomMessageBox.Show($"Ошибка загрузки данных: {ex.Message}", "Ошибка",
                    CustomMessageBoxButton.OK, CustomMessageBoxImage.Error);
            }

            return data;
        }

        private ObservableCollection<InfoServiceReportWithTotal> AddTotalRow(ObservableCollection<InfoServiceReport> data)
        {
            var result = new ObservableCollection<InfoServiceReportWithTotal>();

            foreach (var item in data)
            {
                result.Add(new InfoServiceReportWithTotal
                {
                    DateRecord = item.DateRecord,
                    DeliveryBook = item.DeliveryBook,
                    DeliveryCertificate = item.DeliveryCertificate,
                    EventsCount = item.EventsCount,
                    IsTotal = false
                });
            }

            int totalBooks = data.Sum(x => x.DeliveryBook);
            int totalCertificates = data.Sum(x => x.DeliveryCertificate);
            int totalEvents = data.Sum(x => x.EventsCount);

            result.Add(new InfoServiceReportWithTotal
            {
                DateRecord = DateTime.MinValue,
                DeliveryBook = totalBooks,
                DeliveryCertificate = totalCertificates,
                EventsCount = totalEvents,
                IsTotal = true
            });

            return result;
        }

        private void ShowInfoServiceReportWindow(ObservableCollection<InfoServiceReportWithTotal> data, DateTime startDate, DateTime endDate)
        {
            var reportWindow = new Window
            {
                Title = "Информационное обслуживание",
                Width = 1000,
                Height = 600,
                WindowStartupLocation = WindowStartupLocation.CenterScreen
            };

            var mainPanel = new StackPanel();

            var headerPanel = new StackPanel { Margin = new Thickness(10, 10, 10, 5) };
            headerPanel.Children.Add(new TextBlock
            {
                Text = "Информационное обслуживание",
                FontSize = 18,
                FontWeight = FontWeights.Bold,
                Margin = new Thickness(0, 0, 0, 5)
            });

            headerPanel.Children.Add(new TextBlock
            {
                Text = $"Период: с {startDate:dd.MM.yyyy} по {endDate:dd.MM.yyyy}",
                FontSize = 12,
                Foreground = System.Windows.Media.Brushes.Gray
            });

            headerPanel.Children.Add(new TextBlock
            {
                Text = $"Дата формирования: {DateTime.Now:dd.MM.yyyy HH:mm:ss}",
                FontSize = 11,
                Foreground = System.Windows.Media.Brushes.Gray,
                Margin = new Thickness(0, 3, 0, 0)
            });

            mainPanel.Children.Add(headerPanel);

            var dataGrid = new DataGrid
            {
                AutoGenerateColumns = false,
                IsReadOnly = true,
                Margin = new Thickness(10),
                ItemsSource = data,
                VerticalScrollBarVisibility = ScrollBarVisibility.Auto,
                HorizontalScrollBarVisibility = ScrollBarVisibility.Auto
            };

            dataGrid.Columns.Add(new DataGridTextColumn
            {
                Header = "Дата",
                Binding = new System.Windows.Data.Binding("DisplayDate"),
                Width = new DataGridLength(120)
            });

            dataGrid.Columns.Add(new DataGridTextColumn
            {
                Header = "Выдано книг",
                Binding = new System.Windows.Data.Binding("DeliveryBook"),
                Width = new DataGridLength(100)
            });

            dataGrid.Columns.Add(new DataGridTextColumn
            {
                Header = "Выдано справок",
                Binding = new System.Windows.Data.Binding("DeliveryCertificate"),
                Width = new DataGridLength(100)
            });

            dataGrid.Columns.Add(new DataGridTextColumn
            {
                Header = "Обслужено на мероприятиях (чел.)",
                Binding = new System.Windows.Data.Binding("EventsCount"),
                Width = new DataGridLength(180)
            });

            dataGrid.LoadingRow += (s, e) =>
            {
                var item = e.Row.DataContext as InfoServiceReportWithTotal;
                if (item != null && item.IsTotal)
                {
                    e.Row.Background = System.Windows.Media.Brushes.LightGray;
                    e.Row.FontWeight = FontWeights.Bold;
                }
            };

            mainPanel.Children.Add(dataGrid);
            reportWindow.Content = mainPanel;
            reportWindow.ShowDialog();
        }

            NavigationService?.Navigate(new InventoryActReport());
        }

        // ==================== ВСПОМОГАТЕЛЬНЫЕ МЕТОДЫ ====================
        private bool ValidateDates()
        {
            if (StartDatePicker.SelectedDate == null || EndDatePicker.SelectedDate == null)
            {
                CustomMessageBox.Show("Пожалуйста, выберите обе даты (с и по).", "Ошибка ввода",
                    CustomMessageBoxButton.OK, CustomMessageBoxImage.Warning);
                return false;
            }

            DateTime start = StartDatePicker.SelectedDate.Value.Date;
            DateTime end = EndDatePicker.SelectedDate.Value.Date;

            if (start > end)
            {
                CustomMessageBox.Show("Дата 'с' не может быть позже даты 'по'.", "Ошибка ввода",
                    CustomMessageBoxButton.OK, CustomMessageBoxImage.Warning);
                return false;
            }

            return true;
        }

        private void ShowReportWindow(object data, string title, DateTime? startDate, DateTime? endDate)
        {
            var enumerableData = data as System.Collections.IEnumerable;
            if (enumerableData == null)
            {
                CustomMessageBox.Show("Ошибка: данные не являются коллекцией.", "Ошибка",
                    CustomMessageBoxButton.OK, CustomMessageBoxImage.Error);
                return;
            }

            var reportWindow = new Window
            {
                Title = title,
                Width = 1300,
                Height = 800,
                WindowStartupLocation = WindowStartupLocation.CenterScreen
            };

            var mainPanel = new StackPanel();

            var headerPanel = new StackPanel { Margin = new Thickness(10, 10, 10, 5) };
            headerPanel.Children.Add(new TextBlock
            {
                Text = title,
                FontSize = 18,
                FontWeight = FontWeights.Bold,
                Margin = new Thickness(0, 0, 0, 5)
            });

            if (startDate.HasValue && endDate.HasValue)
            {
                headerPanel.Children.Add(new TextBlock
                {
                    Text = $"Период: с {startDate.Value:dd.MM.yyyy} по {endDate.Value:dd.MM.yyyy}",
                    FontSize = 12,
                    Foreground = System.Windows.Media.Brushes.Gray
                });
            }

            headerPanel.Children.Add(new TextBlock
            {
                Text = $"Дата формирования: {DateTime.Now:dd.MM.yyyy HH:mm:ss}",
                FontSize = 11,
                Foreground = System.Windows.Media.Brushes.Gray,
                Margin = new Thickness(0, 3, 0, 0)
            });

            mainPanel.Children.Add(headerPanel);

            var dataGrid = new DataGrid
            {
                AutoGenerateColumns = true,
                IsReadOnly = true,
                Margin = new Thickness(10),
                ItemsSource = enumerableData,
                VerticalScrollBarVisibility = ScrollBarVisibility.Auto,
                HorizontalScrollBarVisibility = ScrollBarVisibility.Auto
            };

            dataGrid.AutoGeneratingColumn += (s, e) =>
            {
                switch (e.PropertyName)
                {
                    case "IssuanceDate": e.Column.Header = "Дата выдачи"; break;
                    case "BookTitle": e.Column.Header = "Название книги"; break;
                    case "InventoryNumber": e.Column.Header = "Инв. номер"; break;
                    case "ReaderName": e.Column.Header = "Читатель"; break;
                    case "GroupOrPost": e.Column.Header = "Группа/Должность"; break;
                    case "PlannedReturnDate": e.Column.Header = "План. возврат"; break;
                    case "ReturnDate": e.Column.Header = "Дата возврата"; break;
                    case "Status": e.Column.Header = "Статус"; break;
                    case "DaysOverdue": e.Column.Header = "Дней просрочки"; break;
                    case "CardNumber": e.Column.Header = "№ билета"; break;
                    case "FullName": e.Column.Header = "ФИО"; break;
                    case "TypeName": e.Column.Header = "Тип"; break;
                    case "BooksIssued": e.Column.Header = "Всего выдано"; break;
                    case "BooksReturned": e.Column.Header = "Возвращено"; break;
                    case "CurrentlyIssued": e.Column.Header = "На руках"; break;
                    case "OverdueBooks": e.Column.Header = "Просрочено"; break;
                    case "LastIssuanceDate": e.Column.Header = "Последняя выдача"; break;
                    case "AuthorName": e.Column.Header = "Автор"; break;
                    case "Publisher": e.Column.Header = "Издательство"; break;
                    case "Year": e.Column.Header = "Год"; break;
                    case "Genre": e.Column.Header = "Жанр"; break;
                    case "TotalCopies": e.Column.Header = "Всего"; break;
                    case "AvailableCopies": e.Column.Header = "Доступно"; break;
                    case "CopiesInUse": e.Column.Header = "В использовании"; break;
                    case "Title": e.Column.Header = "Название книги"; break;
                    case "ReaderID": e.Column.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed; break;
                    case "IDBook": e.Column.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed; break;
                    case "IdRecord": e.Column.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed; break;
                    case "IsTotal": e.Column.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed; break;
                    case "DisplayDate": e.Column.Header = "Дата"; break;
                    case "DeliveryBook": e.Column.Header = "Выдано книг"; break;
                    case "DeliveryCertificate": e.Column.Header = "Выдано справок"; break;
                    case "EventsCount": e.Column.Header = "Обслужено на мероприятиях (чел.)"; break;
                }

                e.Column.Width = new DataGridLength(1, DataGridLengthUnitType.Auto);

                if (e.PropertyName == "IssuanceDate" || e.PropertyName == "PlannedReturnDate" || e.PropertyName == "DateRecord")
                {
                    if (e.Column is DataGridTextColumn textColumn)
                    {
                        textColumn.Binding.StringFormat = "dd.MM.yyyy HH:mm";
                    }
                }
                else if (e.PropertyName == "ReturnDate" || e.PropertyName == "LastIssuanceDate")
                {
                    if (e.Column is DataGridTextColumn textColumn)
                    {
                        textColumn.Binding.StringFormat = "dd.MM.yyyy";
                    }
                }
            };

            mainPanel.Children.Add(dataGrid);
            reportWindow.Content = mainPanel;
            reportWindow.ShowDialog();
        }

        // ==================== ГЕНЕРАЦИЯ PDF ====================

        private void CreateAndShowPDF<T>(ObservableCollection<T> data, string reportName, DateTime? startDate, DateTime? endDate, string[] headers, Func<T, string[]> getValues)
        {
            string tempFile = Path.GetTempFileName() + ".pdf";

            try
            {
                GeneratePDFWithHeader(data, tempFile, reportName, startDate, endDate, headers, getValues);
                System.Diagnostics.Process.Start(new System.Diagnostics.ProcessStartInfo(tempFile) { UseShellExecute = true });
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                CustomMessageBox.Show($"Ошибка создания PDF: {ex.Message}", "Ошибка",
                    CustomMessageBoxButton.OK, CustomMessageBoxImage.Error);
            }
        }

        private void GeneratePDFWithHeader<T>(ObservableCollection<T> data, string filePath, string title, DateTime? startDate, DateTime? endDate, string[] headers, Func<T, string[]> getValues)
        {
            using (PdfDocument document = new PdfDocument())
            {
                document.Info.Title = title;
                document.Info.Author = "Библиотечная система";
                document.Info.CreationDate = DateTime.Now;

                PdfPage page = document.AddPage();
                page.Orientation = PdfSharp.PageOrientation.Landscape;

                using (XGraphics gfx = XGraphics.FromPdfPage(page))
                {
                    XFont titleFont = new XFont("Arial", 16, XFontStyle.Bold);
                    XFont headerFont = new XFont("Arial", 10, XFontStyle.Bold);
                    XFont dataFont = new XFont("Arial", 9, XFontStyle.Regular);
                    XFont italicFont = new XFont("Arial", 9, XFontStyle.Italic);

                    double yPoint = 40;
                    double leftMargin = 30;
                    double rowHeight = 25;

                    double[] columnWidths = CalculateAutoColumnWidths(gfx, headers, data, getValues, dataFont, page.Width.Point - 60);

                    gfx.DrawString(title, titleFont, XBrushes.Black, new XRect(0, yPoint, page.Width.Point, 30), XStringFormats.TopCenter);
                    yPoint += 35;

                    if (startDate.HasValue && endDate.HasValue)
                    {
                        string periodText = $"Период: с {startDate.Value:dd.MM.yyyy} по {endDate.Value:dd.MM.yyyy}";
                        gfx.DrawString(periodText, italicFont, XBrushes.Gray,
                            new XRect(leftMargin, yPoint, page.Width.Point - 60, 20), XStringFormats.TopLeft);
                        yPoint += 18;
                    }

                    string dateGenerated = $"Дата формирования: {DateTime.Now:dd.MM.yyyy HH:mm:ss}";
                    gfx.DrawString(dateGenerated, italicFont, XBrushes.Gray,
                        new XRect(leftMargin, yPoint, page.Width.Point - 60, 20), XStringFormats.TopLeft);
                    yPoint += 25;

                    double currentX = leftMargin;
                    for (int i = 0; i < headers.Length; i++)
                    {
                        gfx.DrawRectangle(XBrushes.LightGray, currentX, yPoint, columnWidths[i], rowHeight);
                        gfx.DrawString(headers[i], headerFont, XBrushes.Black,
                            new XRect(currentX, yPoint, columnWidths[i], rowHeight), XStringFormats.Center);
                        currentX += columnWidths[i];
                    }
                    yPoint += rowHeight;

                    foreach (var item in data)
                    {
                        string[] values = getValues(item);
                        currentX = leftMargin;

                        for (int i = 0; i < values.Length; i++)
                        {
                            gfx.DrawRectangle(XBrushes.White, currentX, yPoint, columnWidths[i], rowHeight);
                            gfx.DrawString(TruncateString(values[i], (int)(columnWidths[i] / 5)), dataFont, XBrushes.Black,
                                new XRect(currentX + 3, yPoint, columnWidths[i] - 6, rowHeight), XStringFormats.TopLeft);
                            currentX += columnWidths[i];
                        }
                        yPoint += rowHeight;

                        if (yPoint > page.Height.Point - 50)
                        {
                            page = document.AddPage();
                            page.Orientation = PdfSharp.PageOrientation.Landscape;
                            using (XGraphics newGfx = XGraphics.FromPdfPage(page))
                            {
                                yPoint = 40;
                                currentX = leftMargin;
                                for (int i = 0; i < headers.Length; i++)
                                {
                                    newGfx.DrawRectangle(XBrushes.LightGray, currentX, yPoint, columnWidths[i], rowHeight);
                                    newGfx.DrawString(headers[i], headerFont, XBrushes.Black,
                                        new XRect(currentX, yPoint, columnWidths[i], rowHeight), XStringFormats.Center);
                                    currentX += columnWidths[i];
                                }
                                yPoint += rowHeight;
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }

                document.Save(filePath);
            }
        }

        private double[] CalculateAutoColumnWidths<T>(XGraphics gfx, string[] headers, ObservableCollection<T> data, Func<T, string[]> getValues, XFont font, double totalWidth)
        {
            double[] widths = new double[headers.Length];

            for (int i = 0; i < headers.Length; i++)
            {
                widths[i] = gfx.MeasureString(headers[i], font).Width + 10;
            }

            foreach (var item in data)
            {
                string[] values = getValues(item);
                for (int i = 0; i < values.Length && i < headers.Length; i++)
                {
                    double textWidth = gfx.MeasureString(values[i], font).Width + 15;
                    if (textWidth > widths[i])
                    {
                        widths[i] = Math.Min(textWidth, 150);
                    }
                }
            }

            return widths;
        }

        private string TruncateString(string text, int maxLength)
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(text) || text.Length <= maxLength)
                return text;
            return text.Substring(0, maxLength - 3) + "...";
        }

        // ==================== ЭКСПОРТ В EXCEL ====================
        private void ExportBookIssuanceToExcel(ObservableCollection<BookIssuanceReport> data, DateTime startDate, DateTime endDate, bool openAfterExport = false)
        {
            SaveFileDialog saveFileDialog = new SaveFileDialog
            {
                Filter = "Excel файлы (*.xlsx)|*.xlsx",
                FileName = $"Отчёт_Выдача_литературы_{DateTime.Now:yyyyMMdd_HHmm}.xlsx"
            };

            if (saveFileDialog.ShowDialog() == true)
            {
                try
                {
                    ExportToExcelGeneric(data, saveFileDialog.FileName, startDate, endDate, "Отчёт по выдаче литературы", new[]
                    {
                        "Дата выдачи", "Название книги", "Инв. номер", "Читатель",
                        "Группа/Должность", "План. возврат", "Дата возврата", "Статус", "Дней просрочки"
                    }, item => new object[]
                    {
                        ((BookIssuanceReport)item).IssuanceDate.ToString("dd.MM.yyyy HH:mm"),
                        ((BookIssuanceReport)item).BookTitle,
                        ((BookIssuanceReport)item).InventoryNumber,
                        ((BookIssuanceReport)item).ReaderName,
                        ((BookIssuanceReport)item).GroupOrPost,
                        ((BookIssuanceReport)item).PlannedReturnDate.ToString("dd.MM.yyyy"),
                        ((BookIssuanceReport)item).ReturnDate?.ToString("dd.MM.yyyy") ?? "Не возвращена",
                        ((BookIssuanceReport)item).Status,
                        ((BookIssuanceReport)item).DaysOverdue
                    });

                    if (openAfterExport)
                    {
                        System.Diagnostics.Process.Start(new System.Diagnostics.ProcessStartInfo(saveFileDialog.FileName) { UseShellExecute = true });
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        CustomMessageBox.Show($"Отчёт сохранён:\n{saveFileDialog.FileName}", "Успешно",
                            CustomMessageBoxButton.OK, CustomMessageBoxImage.Information);
                    }
                }
                catch (Exception ex)
                {
                    CustomMessageBox.Show($"Ошибка экспорта: {ex.Message}", "Ошибка",
                        CustomMessageBoxButton.OK, CustomMessageBoxImage.Error);
                }
            }
        }
